tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ dpal ldan khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen bde stong zung 'jug kha sbyor dang po'i mgon po dang*// bde chen zag med yon tan phung po'i rgyan ldan dbang bskur 'byor ba'i bdag nyid che// rang bzhin rnam dag mtshan ma med dang spros pa nyer zhi zhi bral chos kyi sku// dmigs med snying rje chen pos yongs gang rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs sku 'gag pa med pa'i gsung*// chos dbyings rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i don ldan rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yang dag thugs// rten dang brten par mdzad pa phrin las 'gog pa med pa'i yon tan bral dang rnam smin mngon par byang chub yan lag bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi bcud bsdus til+li bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal ldan nā ro pa// sgra bsgyur gzhung lugs gsal mdzad mnga' bdag mar pa rje// sgrub mchog mthar phyin mi la rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang*// mnyam pa med pa'i mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu nyid// mthu stobs dpag med bde gshegs phag gru pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab 'jig rten mgon// de yi thugs sras brgyud par bcas rnams la// chos mdzod shing rta'i srol chen 'dzin phyir du// gdul bya'i blo yi pad tshal rgyas pa dang*// blo mun rab rib dri ma bsal bya'i phyir// mchod par brjod nas gsan yig nor bu'i phreng ba 'di spel bya// de yang mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje phrin las gcig tu bsdus shing*/ rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten mgon po'i chos mdzod ma lus pa thugs kyi bang mdzod legs par gtams nas skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la sbyin par mdzad pa/ mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma khams gsum gyi mgon po mnyam pa med pa'i dam pa/ chos kyi rje dbang rin po che rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du dam pa'i chos thob pa la/

dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud bla ma'i rnam par thar pa gser gyi phreng ba'i nang nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam thar dri med nor bu'i phreng ba/ bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma'i brgyud rim/ chos rgyal in+d+ra bhu ti'i rnam thar phun tshogs lha yi pho brang*/ bram chen po sa ra ha'i rnam thar gnyug ma ye shes kyi gar mkhan/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi rnam thar gser ri'i lhun po/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa'i rnam thar dngos grub mchog gi gter kha/ slob dpon tsār+ya pa'i rnam thar tshogs gnyis kyi chu gter/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi pa'i rnam thar 'chi med rdo rje'i ri bo/ slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rnam thar rol mo'i sgra chen/ sum ma ti blo gros bzang mo'i rnam thar 'khor ba'i mtsho chen skem byed/ rje btsun til+li pa'i rnam thar dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun/ jo bo nā ro pa'i rnam thar nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung sel byed zla ba'i 'od zer/ rje btsun lho brag pa'i rnam thar 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar dngos grub kyi snye ma/ rje dwags po lha rje'i rnam thar sman kyi 'dod 'jo/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar gnyis med rtogs pa'i dga' ston/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam thar tshogs gnyis kyi bang mdzod/ mkhan po rin po che'i rnam thar tshul khrims kyi pad dkar/ dbon rin po che'i rnam thar dad pa'i rgyan/ spyan mnga' rin po che'i rnam thar 'khor ba'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal byed/ rgyal ba gcung rin po che'i rnam thar dpag bsam gyi ljon shing*/ thog kha ba rin chen seng ge'i rnam thar seng ge'i ngar skad/ mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod nams kyi rnam thar snyan grags lha yi rnga chen/ bcu gnyis rin po che'i rnam thar sūr+ya stong gi gzi brjid/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal po'i rnam thar rim gnyis dkar ba'i ba dan/

chos kyi rje nyer gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i rnam thar rin po che bdud rtsi'i bum bzang*/ bdag po waṃ gi rnam thar phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po'i rnam thar rtse ba'i gar mkhan/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam thar thugs rje'i 'od zer/ chos kyi rje mnyam med dbang rin po che'i rnam thar 'od zer stong ldan rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje till̥ pa/ mkhas mchog nā ro pa/ mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ rje mi la ras pa/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa/ chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/ kun rgyal ba/ de gnyis char la dharma ra dzās gsan/ de la sman sgom 'od zer seng ge dang*/ bco lnga pa don grub rgyal pos gsan/ de gnyis ka la ldong la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ des 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ des chos rje ngag dbang grags pa/ de la dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos gsan zhing*/ rje des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas legs par gnang ba'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la chen po'i mgur 'bum thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ skor snga ma la/ dka' spyad snying rus kyi skor/ bar ma gnyen 'dun gyi skor/ rmi lam brdar shar ba'i skor/ bde drod ngo 'phrod pa'i skor/ brag dmar mchong lung gi skor/ yon bdag bshen rdor ma'i skor/ ras chung zhal mjal gyi skor/ siṅga la'i nags gseb kyi skor/ spa gro stag tshang gi skor/ skyid phug nyi ma rdzong gi skor/ brag srin mo dang zhus lan gyi skor/

gnyen 'dun rang sar grol ba'i skor/ ston pa dar blo'i skor/ ti phu'i skor/ zhal ta ba yo bde'i skor/ g.yag ru'i skor/ rkyang mgur gyi skor/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i skor/ pha ma drin lan bsab pa'i skor/ sgyu 'phrul rig pa'i skor/ lcam me'i skor/ 'om chung nags ma'i skor/ phug ron sngon mo'i skor/ brag rta sga'i skor/ dom lung brag gseb kyi skor/ brag dkar rta so'i skor/ thong la'i skor/ khyi ra ras pa'i skor/ gtsang g.yas ru 'gron khang gi skor/ brin gyi la so'i skor/ a phyi snang ma'i skor/ chu mig dngul 'bum gyi skor/ zhi ba 'od kyi skor/ gung thang lho sgo'i skor/ legs se 'bum me'i skor/ rabs chad rgan rgon gyi skor/ mang yul gung thang gi skor/ sba mgur gyi skor/ lha rje g.yang nge'i skor/ gcong rong brin gyi skor/ gnya' nam gung chung gi skor/ 'jig rten mig bsgyur gyi mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i zhus lan mgur du bzhengs pa/ ngan rdzong ston pa bho dhi rā dzas yi ger bkod pa snyan ngag glu mu tig gi phreng ba/ dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje la jo mo bkra shis tshe ring mas gtso byas pa'i 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma lngas theg pa mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i zhus lan/ ras pa snga ma la zhi ba 'od kyis sbyar ba/ 'phrang sgrol gnad kyi bar do'i dris lan/ phyag rgya dris lan gyi skor/ ras pa snga ma dang 'dra/ jo bo bon po ri'i skor/ bzang rgyud phyag tshang gi skor/ a phyi rgan mo'i skor/ bring gi lha grong gi skor/ ras chung dbus bzhud kyi skor/ dbus gsar bar ma'i skor/ rong sog rtse'i skor/ mchod khang zhal mjal gyi skor/ dwags po lha rje ma 'ongs lung bstan pa'i skor/ dwags po zhal mjal gyi skor/ dwags po dbus bzhud kyi skor/ lcam me'i bsngo ba'i skor/ snya nam tsa ma'i skor/ dbus gtad zhal ta'i skor/ bring gi smon lam skor rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ ngan rdzong ston pa bho dhi rā dza/ gung thang ras pa/ mgo chung ras pa/ de gnyis kas rgya pho lung pa la/ des lha rin chen rgyal po/ des chos rje spyi dkar ba/ des phug chen pa/ des dar bzang pa/ de nas 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des rin rdzong dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ des la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ des 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ des mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ des chos kyi rje dbang rin po che la/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar gser phreng*/ bstan bcos thar pa rin po che'i rgyan/ phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgom rim/ phyag rgya chen po gsal byed/ grub snying*/ sgam po pa'i gsung sgros/ rnam rtog don dam ngo sprod/ rje rin po che'i mgur ma 'dre bzhi rtsad gcod/ snying po ngo sprod/ don dam gter mdzod/ zung 'jug rnam 'gyur gyi man ngag rje dwags po la dwags po sgom tshul gyi zhus lan/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhus lan/ rnal 'byor chos g.yung gi zhus lan/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa dang zhus lan gyi skor/ zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi thun mong ma yin pa gros 'debs bdud rtsi phreng ba/ tshogs chos mu tig phreng ba/ dwags po rin po che'i tshogs chos/ tshogs chos yon tan phun tshogs/ tshogs chos legs mdzes ma/ bkra shis phun tshogs/ gsung sgros thor bu ba/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor/ rdo rje'i mgur/ phag mo'i gzhung mdo/ rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang*/ tshigs bcad brgyad ma'i 'grel ba/ thabs lam gyi sngon 'gro/ khrid chos mu tig phreng ba/ dmar khrid gsang chen/ bar do gsum gyi gdams pa/ snyan brgyud gsal ba'i me long*/ snyan brgyud brjed byang ma/

zhal gdams gsang mdzod/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gtum mo ḍoṃ bhi rnam gsum/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag skor/ bcud bsdus phreng ba/ skye med phyag rgya chen po/ dwags po sgom pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar/ bslab sdom rin po che'i phreng ba/ lde mig bzhi/ thabs lam be'u bum/ bla ma'i man ngag lhan cig skyes sbyor cha gnyis pa/ rje sgam po pa'i rnam par thar pa'i rgyan mchog phyag rgya chen po bka' drin bcu gcig pa 'phrul gyi me long*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi ngo sprod chos sku 'khor yug ma/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ de'i lo rgyus/ dwags po'i chos bzhi rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mdo sngags gnyis las thabs lam chos drug dang*/ phyag chen gyi khrid phal mo che sogs sngags kyi rgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu/ de la dbon po sgom tshul gyis gsan cing*/ khu dbon de gnyis char la karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas gsan/ de nas 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pak+shi/ grub chen u rgyan pa/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ chos kyi rje dbang rin po ches/ des shākya'i dge slong spyan snga ā nan+da rat+na la gnang ba'o// yang na rang byung rdo rje yan 'dra la/ des rtogs ldan dar rgyal ba/ des mkha' spyod dbang po la/ de nas gong bzhin no// yang mkha' spyod dbang po/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa/ de gnyis ka la la phyi bas/ de phyin gong bzhin no// khyad par phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ thabs lam chos drug gi bskor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rje dwags po yan gong dang 'dra la/ rje des dbon po sgom tshul la/ des zhang g.yu brag pa/ ro skam ras chen/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/

zur phug pa chen po/ ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ ras chen gdan gcig pa/ de nas la phyi ba phyin gong bzhin no// phyag chen zhus lan skor rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ ring brgyud dwags po yan 'dra la/ nye brgyud ni/ chos kyi rje dwags po/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/ kun rgyal ba/ de gnyis ka la dharma rā dzas/ des sman sgom 'od zer seng ge/ des bco lnga ba don grub rgyal po/ de gnyis ka la la phyi bas gsan/ de phyin gong dang 'dra'o// mdo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bka' gdams nas rgyud pa thun mong ba rnams yin te/ thub dbang*/ byams pa/ thogs med/ zhi ba lha/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ spyan snga ba/ rgyal sgom/ rje dwags po phyin gong bzhin no// sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag gi rnam par 'phrul pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po'i drung du/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum cha lag dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i chos tshan ni/ yug thang pa brtson 'grus dpal gyis bsgrigs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ mtshon cha gsang ba'i mdzod sgo dbye lugs/ sku lus kyi bkod pa bcu gnyis/ rnam thar rin po che mi zad rgya mtsho'i gter/ skye rabs rnam gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul/ sems bskyed mu tig phreng chen/ yang mu tig phreng chung*/ bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ bstan bcos blo gros 'jug pa'i sa bcad/ bstan bcos blo gros 'jug pa/ de'i bstod 'grel/ rab gnas dpe mdzod ma/ rab gnas bcu ma/ rab gnas tshig don bsdus pa/ rab gnas sngags lugs dang*/

mdo lugs sogs rab gnas kyi yig chung lnga/ bstan bcos mar me'i phreng ba/ bstan bcos nor bu'i rgyal po/ dam pa brgyad kyi bstan bcos/ seng ge dpal gyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos/ bstan bcos khams gsum dbyer med/ zung gsum ya drug rtsa ltung gi rnam bshad don gsal sgron me/ chos spyi dang mthun pa'i zhal gdams/ bstan bcos 'khor ba rtsad gcod/ bar do'i zhus lan/ 'chi ba brtag pa dang bslu ba'i thabs/ yab sras kyi tshe sgrub/ bstan bcos glang chen rol pa/ bstan bcos gnas lugs rgya mtsho/ rgyan mdzes pa gser gyi cod pan/ bstan bcos gnas lugs brjod pa/ gces bsdus rin chen phreng ba nas bsdus pa bde gshegs chen po nas mdzad pa/ rang la brjed bskul/ rdo rje'i mgur gsum/ chang gsol tshul/ gsol 'debs sgyur gzer zhi ba ma/ nye gnas la gdams pa/ bde gshegs sgam po pa'i bstod pa tshan pa bcu gcig dus mchod chen po bzhi yi ngos 'dzin mdo lugs dang jo bo lugs/ chos bzhi dang nyes pa rab zad kyi 'grel ba/ gtor ma'i de nyid/ yi ge brgya pa'i gzungs chog phag mo'i lag mchod/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i srung 'khor/ ka pa la'i brtag thabs/ gegs sel zhal gdams ma/ rnal 'byor zas bdun brten pa'i man ngag zhabs rjes bzhengs pa'i bstan bcos/ bka' brgyud kyi bkra shis/ yang bkra shis gcig rigs lnga phar phyin drug lta sgom spyod gsum gyi bkra shis/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa dpal chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas mdzad pa'i smon lam don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phag mo gru pa nyid kyis dus kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ de nyid kyi dag pa'i zhing mngon par dga' ba zhes bya bar skye ba 'dzin pa'i ched du smon lam sbyar ba/ chos drug gi thabs lam/ bar do'i dmar khrid/ thabs lam lhug pa ma/ thabs lam tshig bcad ma'i lhan thabs rin chen gter mdzod/ rtsa rlung rgyu 'bras ma/ cig car rim gyis ngo sprod/

lus dag ma dag gi rnam dbye/ thabs lam tshigs bcad ma'i ngo sprod/ lnga ldan shog khra ma/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshig bcad ma/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod/ lhan cig skyes sbyor go cha gnyis ma dang*/ rkyen bzhi ma/ rnal 'byor bzhi chen mo/ 'bring po/ rnal 'byor bzhi tshigs bcad ma nyang sgom gyis zhus pa/ yang tshig bcad ma chung ba/ bsam sgom rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi ched du mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ lha rje rin po che la phag mo gru pas zhus pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi dang zhal gdams/ phyag rgya chen po snying po'i don/ phyag rgya chen po'i zhus lan ngo bo'i ga dar/ zhus lan nya ga 'gag dril/ yang zhus lan yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ yang zhus lan nyi shu pa/ phyag chen gnyug ma chig chod/ don spyi zil gnon/ snang ba rang sems kyi ngo sprod/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs mdo rgyud nas lung drangs pa/ ras chung pa'i bsam gtan thun 'jog zhi byed rmang lam ma/ ri chos bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ rin po che'i them skas/ rin po che'i 'phrul skas/ rin chen rgyan 'dra/ rin chen sgron me/ rin chen brtse ba'i sgron me/ bstan bcos rin po che'i bang mdzod/ rin chen gsal ba/ rin chen gser gyi ska rags/ rin po che'i ska rags rin po che bai ḍūr+ya'i them skas zhes pa/ rin chen them skas kyi gdams ngag gsang sngags lam rim them skas/ ku sā li'i tshogs gsog ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur/ phyag rgya chen po rnams la gdams pa/ gling ras kyi zhus lan le tshan khrigs dmigs skor zhal gdams/ grub thob kyi zhal gdams blo la zung zhes pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal yig brgya'i bzlas pa/ zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa'i zhal mnga' nas mdzad pa'i smon lam don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phag mo gru pa nyid kyis dus kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ de nyid kyi dag pa'i zhing mngon par dga' ba zhes bya bar skye ba 'dzin pa'i ched du smon lam sbyar ba/

dpal phag mo gru pa'i tshogs chos mun pa sel bar byed pa bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor/ yang tshogs chos ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba rin po che'i sgron me/ yang tshogs chos rin po che'i gter mdzod/ yang tshogs chos zab yangs rgya mtsho/ yang tshogs chos gces bsdus rin chen phreng ba/ yang tshogs chos chen mo/ mdo lung rin chen spungs pa/ gser mdog mchod ston la gdams pa/ spar phu ba'i dbang gi zhus lan/ rmi lam sprul sku'i zhus lan/ thar pa bskul ba'i gdams pa/ nyag ston shes rab 'od la gdams pa/ 'khor ba zhen pa'i skyon brjod/ gros 'debs mu tig phreng ba/ dge bshes chos blo la springs pa/ 'dod 'jo rin po che'i bstan bcos dge bshes dbang phyug gzhon nu la gdams pa/ lha sa ba dar ma skyabs la gdams pa/ mched rmog cog chen po la mdo khams su springs pa/ dge bshes dbas chen po la springs pa/ dge bshes rta nag pa la springs pa/ dbang gzhon la bskur ba/ dbu sgom la bskur ba/ sbab la bskur ba/ ko ston la bskur ba/ dge bshes jo sras la bskur ba/ jo mo rdzong lcam la springs pa/ kun bzang la springs yig yon bdag shes rab 'khor la springs pa/ gwa zi byang seng la bskur ba/ dge bshes rmog chos blo la gdams pa/ thar pa sgrub 'dod ma/ dge slong byang chub 'bar la gdams pa/ rlangs seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi zhus lan drug cu pa/ bstan bcos bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ lha btsun sna ral ba la gdams pa/ rtogs ldan gros 'debs rin po che'i spring yig sogs chos tshan gsum/ mkhar sgang pa'i dge bshes chos kyi bla ma la zhen bskul rin chen 'bar ba/ grogs 'cham pa rdzogs chen pa la gdams pa sogs chos tshan bco lnga/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi zin bris chung ngu gnyis/ tsā ri'i sgom chen la gdams pa gnyis/ gsal byed me long*/ dge bshes 'dul 'dzin la springs pa/ phyag rgya chen po gnas lugs ma/ lam mthar thug nas 'bras bu 'thob pa bdud rtsi gsum gyi gdams pa/

dag bya gsum dag par byed pa/ sa le lha ston la gdams pa/ dge bshes rgya le la gdams pa/ thar pa rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ stag sgom la gdams pa gnyis/ skul 'debs ma/ bye sgom thung la gdams pa/ 'gru ra rin rgyal la gdams pa gnyis/ 'gyug ge la gdams pa/ 'od dpag bye sgom gnyis la gdams pa/ yig rten dar cham ma/ grogs ngan spang ba/ rgyu 'bras gtsor ston/ gwa zi dge 'dun skyabs la bskur ba/ stag sgom la gdams pa gnyis/ tre bo dge dpal/ dge bshes dar pa/ dge bshes rmog chen po/ sngon gyi mched grags dbas chen po// tre'o dkon mchog dpal sogs la gdams pa/ sems la gros 'debs dge bshes mchod ston dang stag sgom gnyis la gdams pa/ lag bde'i bstan bcos/ rgyal mtshan 'bar la gdams pa/ zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i smon lam don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phag mo gru pa nyid kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ de nyid kyi dag pa'i zhing mngon par dga' ba zhes bya bar skye ba 'dzin pa'i ched du smon lam du sbyar ba/ bir+wa pa'i lo rgyus/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ lam 'bras dpe mdzod ma/ lam 'bras kyi bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ lus sbyong gi spe'u chung*/ lam 'bras kyi rlung sbyor gyi khrid yig rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'khor 'das thun mong ba sogs gsal byed kyi yi ge/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i zhal gdams/ lam 'bras kyi gegs sel zhal gdams/ bir+wa pa'i gsang rgyud/ ā li kā li las sna tshogs la 'jug pa/ lwa ba pa'i gdams skor/ lwa ba pa'i thabs lam rdo rje'i tshigs gsum ma/ gshan grong ba la gdams pa/ bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis la bstod pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs lag mchod dang bcas pa/ bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud don gsal bar byed pa bdud rtsi'i thig le/ dpal mgon po'i stong thun/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i lo rgyus/

dpal nag po chen po'i gzhung lugs mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub/ yang mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub gcig dge bshes sog la mdo khams su springs pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal mgon po'i gdams pa las sbyor gyi gnad/ sku rags ma'i gsang sgrub kyi zab don bsdus pa'i man ngag sku rags ma'i srog bzhi ma/ dpal mgon lcam dral du sgrub pa'i thabs sku rags ma'i ṭī ka sku rags ma'i gnad kyi gdams pa/ nag po chen po'i sngags kyi them yig sku rags ma'i dgra bsad chung ba/ be'u pa'i thun gyi thad kar sbyar ba/ yang sku rags ma'i dgra bsad che chung gsum gyi sngags/ dpal mgon po'i zhal nyer lta'i gdams pa/ spu gri bsnol ma'i sgrub thabs mngon rtogs le'u bdun ma/ hūm̐ skyes ma/ lwa ba pa'i thabs lam/ lam 'bras dpe brjod ma rnams legs par thob pa'i lwa ba pa'i thabs lam skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ lwa ba pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa/ lam 'bras dpe mdzod ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen kun snying*/ 'gro mgon rin po che/ spyi yi brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ bcu gnyis pa/ slob dpon dbang phyug bsod nams/ spyan snga grags pa shes rab/ slob dpon dkon mchog rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ bla ma rin chen shes rab/ bla ma smon lam dpal 'byor/ rje btsun kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// mdo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i thun mong ba rnams te/

thub dbang*/ byams pa/ thogs med/ zhi ba lha/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ rgyal sgom/ rje dwags po/ 'gro mgon rin po che/ de phyin gong bzhin no// slar yang*/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i bka' 'bum cha lag dang bcas pa thob pa'i chos tshan ni/ thub pa chen po la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul la bstod pa gar nyams/ rje phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar nyams len rin po che mi zad pa rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba/ rnam thar rdo rje rin po che 'bar ba/ rnam thar phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ rnam thar zad mi shes pa'i za ma tog bkod pa/ rnam thar rma bya seng ge ma/ mthong ba don yod ma/ chos kyi rje de nyid 'phags pa klu sgrub yin par dgra bcom pa sing ga gling pas lung bstan tshul/ yang chos kyi rje de nyid klu sgrub yin par rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas paṇa chen shākya shrī la gsung tshul lo// chos rje paṇa chen shākya shrī'i spyan sngar zhus pa/ de'i zhus len paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa chos skyes me tog gi phreng ba/ 'gyur med 'od gsal dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i bstod pa dus gsum bdag nyid ma/ rab zhi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor slob dpon pad+ma'i bstod pa/ tsin+ta ma ṇi rin po che 'bar ba'i phreng ba/ dum dum khrigs su bris pa gces pa'i snying po/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lta bu bya ba'i rim pa/ bsil byed tsan dan gyi phreng ba/ nam mkha' lding zhes bya ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa/ rgyal sras rnams kyi rim pa rin po che'i 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan/ bstan bcos blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun nas sgo yi theg pa zab mo'i gdams ngag thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa 'khor lo rin po che lta bu/ ti se'i bstod pa/ glag mo brag dkar/ gnam mtsho'i bstod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bla ma rin po ches mdo rgyud du ma la brten nas bstod pa/

nyams su myong ba dri ma med pa'i bdud rtsi yag zher ston pa shes rab bla mas zhus pa/ zhus lan thor bu dbang gi rgyal po/ chos kun sems nyid gdod nas rnam dag thabs min dka' thub kyis mi grol ba spyi lam zab mo/ brdung brdung tag tag mos gus bya ba'i rim pa sgom pa rin chen seng ges zhus pa/ 'ur 'ded chen mor grags pa tshad ldan bla ma/ chos kun sems nyid dkyil 'khor mnyam nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo rang la zhe khrel/ thams cad dbang du byed pa'i gdams ngag ku re'i dad pa gang che dpa' ba/ dpa' bo chen po'i sgrub thabs/ gegs sel bogs 'don grags pa rgyal pos zhus pa/ bstan chos glang chen rol pa mnyam nyid gdod nas dag pa/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i don gyi gnad bsdus pa/ skyob mdzad bkra shis tshigs bcad gcig nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ shākya'i dge slong ldom bu pa rin chen dpal gyis sgom pa rdo rje grags la springs pa/ mi chos lha dam bde chen rang byung ngo*// pha mnyam med brtse chen ma/ khros pa'i nga rgyal zab mo/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bstan pa mkha' dang mnyam pa'i/ ro gcig rtogs nas bag chags slongs tshul lo// ku re pag shi dpal ldan phag mo gru/ ku re pag shi dam pa rin po che/ gdan sa 'dzin lugs pha chos rje/ rnal 'byor pa'i gsum/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams/ rang rig 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mngon drug ma/ dus mchod bzhi yi chung ba/ bstan pa 'di yi sgo/ shes pa gar yod pa der yod pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ rten 'brel 'byed pa rang bzhin rnam dag mda' snun 'o dod/ badz+ra rā dza dharma ka ya/ gnyis med thugs rjes phyag 'tshal 'dud/ thabs lam a ya tsa lha yi rnal 'byor/ gtum mo gnad kyi sbyor ba/ bla ma dam pa'i dbyer med 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ ma bcos rnam lnga spar phu ba la gsungs pa/ rab kyi yang rab 'pho ba/ de gang yin dgu tshigs gcig gdams ngag dam pa pha ltar byams pa/

tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan/ dge sbyor shes pa bkol du btub pa bar chad sel tshul/ bslab gsum rdo rje'i lus la snyoms pa/ rje rang byung chen po'i zhabs ma/ thabs kyi rgyal po rnam gsum/ bcom ldan snang mdzad dpal/ snying rje nyi ma/ skyo shas go cha ma/ gzhan gyi skyon la mi rigs pa/ gzhan sems mgu ba'i gdams ngag bdag gcig pu ma/ bsod nams tshogs kyi kha 'dzin dkon mchog gsum ma/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung bzhi/ oṃ na mo/ byang chub sems la nan tan/ thog mar gnyid las langs pa/ snying nas thar pa sgrub lags/ gces drug ma/ 'phur zhes bya/ slob dpon gdan sa ba la gdams pa sgrub byed ting 'dzin/ so so gang 'dod dpal phag mo gru pa la/ da yong gsum ma/ mchog dang thun mong ma/ sho shum ma'i mdza' bo spyir ris drug bsgom btsun pa rgyal la phul ba dmigs gtad kyi sgom/ nam mkha'i bu mo skye ho skal ldan ma/ rang nyid sgom par bya ba 'jug pa'i sgo/ bden pa mthong ba'i rnam thar lhan cig skyes pa rang byung*/ khro bzhu ba'i man ngag dge ba'i bshes gnyen ma/ dbyangs su mdzad pa kye kye gson dang rgyal ba/ dga' dga' skyid skyid kyi bstan bcos bde chen kun bzang*/ a log ces pa pha bla ma rin chen/ phag pa'i phreng ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ bsam grub ras chen la phul ba pha mnyam med/ zhal ta'i yi ge dge 'dun rnams kyi spyan sngar zhu ba/ rnam bcu dbang ldan ang nyon mongs/ bla ma dris lan mig med 'jig rten/ 'phrang rnam bdun bsal ba lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying gang gi drin/ spra tshil slong ba skyes chen gang zhig 'dzin pa spang bar gdams pa/ rnal 'byor bzang rnam thar 'khor ba'i 'dam las sgrol ba/ dus gsum gnyen po gang dran ma/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i srog snying nyes pa rab zad/ do pa la gsungs pa sems babs la gnas na/ rang sems gros kyis ni mi 'gyur/

nang gi rten 'brel zab mo kye kye rnal 'byor/ zab dang rgya che dpag dka'/ rkyen bzhi rgyu rkyen/ bka' drin che tshul/ dpon sgom rdo rje seng ge la khams su bskur ba chos kun gdod nas skye med/ lha bzo'i zhal ta 'das dang ma byon/ yang lha bzo'i zhal ta bla ma rin chen/ lha chung bzo'i mtshan nyid/ phag mo gru pa la rigs drug tu bstod pa rje dus gsum rgyal ba/ gi chen po 'di la byar mi rung 'gro ba'i bla ma/ cang shes na re 'di skad/ grub thob dge ba'i bshes gnyen la zhu ba bkra shis dang bde legs/ mkhan po seng seng ba'i spyan sngar springs pa bla ma rin po ches/ khur cig spang ga bla ma yi dam/ rje btsun ras pa la springs pa bra chad dwags po/ bla ma rin po ches yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i spyan sngar/ 'bab rong gi gdan sar bskur ba dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sra ston rdo rje skyabs la springs pa/ bla ma rin po ches rje btsun rdo rje rgyal la springs pa/ bla ma rin po che rje btsun ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bdun pa/ e chung du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe zhal gzigs pa'i dus mdzad pa/ shākya thub pa'i bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi bstaud pa rkang pa gcig gis ma tshang ba'i tshigs bcad bzhi/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la bstod pa tshigs bcad gnyis/ rje btsun 'phags ma'i bstod pa gsol 'debs tshigs bcad gnyis/ yang 'phags ma la gsol 'debs sho lo ka gcig rje btsun ma sgrol ma la bstod pa sho lo bka' bcu gsum/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bstod pa'i gsol 'debs sho lo ka bcu pa ri bo ta la/ theg pa chen po'i tshul dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ong ges zhus pa/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgya mtsho'i rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba shākya'i sras dge sbyong sgom pa la gsal ba dbang phyug gis zhus pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa gdong po rgyan pa zhes bya ba shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong gsal ba dbang phyug gis zhus pa sems kyi de nyid/

slob pa gsum gyis legs par bsdus pa gsang sngags kyis nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ spangs dang ye shes phun sum tshogs/ sdom pa gsum gsal bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug steng po bas zhus pa/ stobs bcu ting 'dzin/ nyams len bslab khog chen mo/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas so// snying po la yod pa'i gdams ngag dus gsum rgyal ba/ tshad med bzhi yi gdams ngag sangs rgyas thams cad/ yon bdag sgom pa la gsungs pa ji snyed nor rdzas/ bla ma rin chen rnam lnga dus gsum rgyal ba/ blo bde'i zhal spro lha dang bcas pa/ rin chen dbang phyug nam mkha' lding*/ tshad ldan bla ma/ snying po dpe med 'o che/ snying na ngu bro gnas skabs kyi/ zhes pa'i snying po dri ma med pa'i dpal rin chen phreng ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ dge slong grags pa'i 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa skyes chen/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar zhus pa dang yid skyo ba sel bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi/ sgom pa byang chub grags kyis zhus pa 'khor ba sdug bsngal zhes pa/ mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang tshig phyag 'tshal 'dud/ gegs sel gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba dge sbyong dar ma gzhon nus zhus pa/ gnyis med thugs bya ba nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rin chen snying po zhes bya ba/ dge slong dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa skyes chen/ zab dang rgya chen po'i gdams pa bla ma dam pa/ thag chod gsum gyi gdams ngag rdo rje phur pa ki li ki la yā/ sems nyid/ 'dan ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab 'od gsal la springs pa dus gsum rgyal ba/ a ru ra'i chig thang*/ dus gsum gyi mi 'khrugs smon lam/ chos kun 'jam dbyangs/ sems bskyed skyob pa/ glen pa nyams len gdams ngag rnam gsum/ log rtog bsang ba/ nam mkha' 'dra/ rang sems rdo rje bla ma/ zab dang rgya che'i gdams ngag 'di lta bas/

phu kha ba'i gangs la lta/ bla ma thugs rje che/ rang la gros 'debs thub pa chen po/ dge sbyong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis zhus pa/ he badz+ra lha dang*/ gzhi ji bzhin lha dang bcas/ dge bshes be ris zhus pa zab mo gnad kyi phreng ba/ skyes chen/ yang zab mo gnad kyi phreng ba be ris zhus pa/ bla med theg pa'i gnad bsdus zhal gdams rin po che dge bshes bla brang bas zhus pa dus gsum/ rin po che'i man ngag sgom pa ye shes brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ skyi shod pa dkon mchog 'od la gdams pa/ skyi shod pa dkon mchog 'od la gsungs pa/ zhal ta tshig gsum ma sgom pa shes rab 'od la gdams pa/ snying gtam tshig gcig co za dge slong la gdams pa/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po/ bzod gsol/ chos gzhan med bya ba/ dge bshes dung rung sgang pa la gdams pa/ 'phan yul ba brtson 'grus dpal la/ rngod du springs pa/ dge bshes sgo na ba la gsungs pa/ bkra shis seng ge la gsungs pa/ bkra shis seng ges zhus pa'i lan/ bsod snyoms kyis mi brel ba/ lha yi rgyan gyi rnam dag chos rjes mdzad pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga gdams ngag dang bcas pa rin po che 'bar ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ rgyal sras rnams kyi bsam pa rin po che skye ba'i rim pa mu tig phreng ba/ dge slong shes rab ye shes kyis zhus pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i tshul lugs/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgom thabs gshin po dang 'brel tshad/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i bzlas sgom/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs chog bla ma rin po che'i phyag bzhes kyi maṇ+ḍal/ gsol 'debs zhing dang bsam pa/ rgyun gyi bsngo ba dang gsol 'debs snying gtam ma/ rang sems sgom pa/ dus gtor gtor rdzongs/ rnam 'byed sgo gtan gleng gzhi/ nye drung brtse ba'i bstan bcos/ gtor ma cha bcu/ sngags dang 'dul ba'i bslab pa tha dad ma yin par bstan pa/ drang srong chen po'i rnam thar/ thabs la mkhas pa/ mang rje zhig po'i zhu ba bco lnga/

de'i zhus lan gser gyi phreng ba/ stag lung thang pa khams su gshegs par dgongs pa la bshol btab pa/ gtsigs chen/ nyes pa lnga spang pa/ rnal 'byor gyi mdun pa rang byung kun bzang*/ bram ze chen po'i phyag rgya chen po thog bab/ zhus tshigs gsum pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs sgrub pa/ zhus tshigs gsum pa'i lan/ gang legs kyi mdun ma/ rin po ches sgam por gdugs phul dus mdzad pa/ gzhen bskul rin chen 'bar ba/ gsol 'debs tshigs bcad bzhi pa/ lho pa mon sgom gyi slob ma la springs pa/ sgril bas chos tshan brgya dang bdun bcu don lnga/ rdo rje theg pa'i snying po mdor bsdus pa rdo rje ye shes kyis zhus pa/ snying gtam tshig gcig springs pa/ phag mo gru pa'i 'bul yig bsam shes pa'i sdengs chen sangs rgyas/ gdan sa'i gnyer gtad pa/ go chod kyi bstod pa gnyis med ye shes kyi phreng ba/ thabs shes rab kyis 'chi ba slu ba/ yon bdag dgra lha rgyal la springs pa/ dus mchod chen po bzhi nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa spyi dang bye brag so sor bstan pa/ gsang gtam chen mo thugs kyi nying khu/ lnga ldan nyams len dang dge bsnyen bsrung bar gdams pa/ sgrub pa'i gnas byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag mi mjed zhing gi bsngags pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos bzhi/ gsal byed ye shes kyi sgron me/ ming bzang po rgyal ba sgom gzhon gyi nu bo ye tshul gyis zhus pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po'i cho ga yang sprin chen po'i cho ga dar ma shes rab kyis zhus pa/ char 'bebs kyi dam tshig mkhas pas mi khrel ba/ sga pa dar ma shes rab kyis zhus pa'i tshig bcad/ rje btsun ma par+ṇa sha wa rī/ ri khrod ma la gsol ba btab pa'i thabs dge bshes stod lung pas zhus pa/ rje btsun ma par+ṇa sha wa rī'i gzungs chog de'i bum sman/ ri khrod ma'i bstod pa sho lo ka bzhi/ don gyi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba dge sbyong bsod nams dpal gyis zhus pa/

rgyal ba rnams kyi gzhung lam/ bdud bzlog bag yod gsum ldan/ slongs 'dag tshul/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen stod chen pos zhus pa/ spros pa gcod pa'i yi ge nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ bsu ba bya ba'i rim pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bod du byon dus gsungs pa/ slob ma la chos mi gsang ba/ bdud zlog bag yod gsum ldan/ bris sku dang rab gnas kyi tshul lung las byung ba/ rtags ston sngags/ sku khams dwangs pa'i dus su mdzad pa dad pa gsum brtan pa/ rang gi bu la bstan pa'i khur gtad pa/ zung 'jug gi gdams pa nyes pa kun sel/ mi 'bral chos kyi snying po rje btsun ras pa la springs pa/ yon tan gyi bogs 'don rten 'brel gsal bar byed pa shes rab sgron ma/ bstan bcos don nges par bkod pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i rten 'brel/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'bri sgur gyi zhus lan/ seng ras kyis zhus pa/ bla ma smar pa la bstod pa/ bla ma smar pa la springs yig snying po don gyi lam rim bsdus pa'i snying po dge slong rgyal ba yon tan gyis zhus pa/ de'i sa bcad/ sgam por bca' khrims gdams pa gsan nas mnyes pa'i skyid skyid ring mo dga' la drin chags/ skyid skyid legs dgu dag byed gleng gzhi/ nams kyang 'dus kyi rang bzhin/ gtan gyi so nam/ da res tshad bu/ bden pa rnam lnga/ zhal lta bka' drin rjes dran/ rnal 'byor pa'i goms rtags/ gegs dang bar chad gnyis med ngang du gyur tshul ku su lu'i gsang tshig gnad gcig chog dus/ thugs smon/ gsang sngags kyi lam/ nyes pa rtsad nas 'dag tshul/ mtshams pa dang las pa la gdams pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bstan pa/ rdo rje ri zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos dge bshes rnams gnyis kyis zhus pa/ zab cing rgya che ba sngo ba'i gnad kyi man ngag gces pa'i snying po/ dge bshes klong thang ba la snying gtam/ gsum tshan gsum gyi gdams ngag

chos bdun gyi gdams pa/ so so thar pa'i mdo yi don bsdus pa/ dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa mkhan po dmyal pas zhus pa/ zab pa'i gdams pa gces pa'i snying po/ sems kyi rang bzhin bstan pa/ bla ma'i gdams ngag 'chi med bdud rtsi/ bla ma byang chub shes rab la gdams pa/ klong thang ba la gdams pa/ kha rag pa la gnyug mar gnas par gdams pa/ go'u shrī ras pa la gdams pa/ skyid ston la gdams pa/ pha phogs 'chi med/ ra cheng zab mo/ zla shod sman pa'i da li/ chos babs la gnas pa/ bde legs bla ma/ 'byams yig ye bla ma gdams pa gdug pa gnas sar dgon pa mi bya ba/ mkhan po brag thog pa la gdams pa/ spros pa gcad pa gdan sa pa la gdams pa/ rje btsun mi la'i gsung ngo bo dbyer med/ dge sbyong gnod pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa/ bla ma lha yi zhu ba nyer gcig gi lan/ shi ri phug pa la gdams pa rgyu mtshan brjod pa/ nyams len snying po/ snying gtad slob mas gros 'dri ba la phan pa'i gdams pa/ rang la smad pa dang rje la gsol ba gdab pa/ dge bshes skya sbom la gdams pa/ snying tshig gi gdams pa dpon chen po'i spyan sngar springs pa/ rgyal ba ye tshul gyis yum stong phrag brgya pa gser gyis bzhengs pa la gsungs pa/ de nyid mchod pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams bsngo ba/ khri gtsug ral pa can la gdams pa/ rngod pa'i sgom chen rnams la gdams pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams la gdams pa/ me tog phreng 'dzin/ spyan 'dren la gsungs pa/ gegs sel chen mo/ gsang sngags gegs sel/ ri khrod rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gdams pa/ gros 'dun chen mo chos brgyad kyi spros pa gcod pa'i man ngag dri ba lnga pa sgrub pa'i man ngag gtan gyi so nam rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel/ char ka'i gleng bzhi/ lta spyod sgom gsum ya ma bral ba/ gzhon nu shes rab kyi dri ba brgyad kyi zhu ba/ de'i lan phyed kyis lhag pa'i tshigs bcad bcu pa/ zhus tshig bdun pa/ de'i lan tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa/

bral ba rnam bzhi phyed kyis lhag pa'i tshigs bcad bcu pa/ yin bdun tshigs bcad lnga pa/ phyag chen sbar 'dzin tshigs bcad bdun/ bu gcig rnam thar tshigs bcad dgu/ spros pa bcad nas ri la 'gro bar bskul ba tshigs bcad gcig gsang tshig bla med/ rang srog rang gis bsrung ba/ bar chad spang bar gdams pa rkang pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis/ 'phags pa do pas zhus pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig chos rgyal yum sras la rten gyi yon bdag tu bskul ba/ bdag 'dzin gtong thabs/ bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ yan lag bdun pa/ yan lag bdun pa gser khang ma/ yan lag bdun pa gser khang ma'i mngon rtogs/ ngag 'don nyams len gyi rim pa/ snying gtam tshigs su brjod pa/ skyau khams pa la gsungs pa/ rten gyi so nam/ gces pa bcu yi gdams ngag bdag nyid chen po'i sku re/ dpal shrī phug pa la gdams pa tshigs bcad drug pa/ jo bo la gsungs pa tshigs bcad bcu pa/ skyid pas thol le rgyal/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa gnyis med rdo rje rin po che/ kha rag pa la gdams pa bkra shis drug pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gdams pa/ 'dan ma ye shes grags pa la gdams pa/ smṛ tir 'gron po bcom dus gsungs pa/ dbyangs mkhan la gdams pa/ sprang po hang dang la gdams pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i gsung lan yi ger sbyar ba/ gtor ma nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dngul chu'i bcud len/ smyon pa'i lag rjes tshigs bcad gsum dang rkang pa gsum/ snying po bsdus pa'i gdams ngag dbu sgom pa la springs pa/ shrī ri phug pa la bsngags pa/ rag shi mkhan po la gsungs pa nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i chos bdun/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkur thabs bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba nyi ma'i gzi brjid/ rme dor stengs pa la springs pa/ yod dge bsngo ba'i kha 'dzin/ nyes tshogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje dge bshes shākya rgyal pos zhus pa/

nor sgrub so nam/ bstan rtsis/ shid bya thabs dpal chen shrī ri phug pa'i bsnyun rmed/ phyi nang gnad kyi rten 'brel rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsang tshig dpal chen po la gdams pa/ skyer ston la gdams pa byang chub sems gnyis/ bka' gdams pa la gdams pa 'chi ba slu ba/ mi 'khrugs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi/ don gyi gsang chen yi ge/ thugs la btags tshigs bcad gcig dang rkang pa gsum/ za tshad 'thung tshad thabs mkhas/ dbon sher 'byung gi zhus lan/ bla ma lha la gdams pa/ slob dpon rong mdo ba la gdams pa/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa gcig sde snod gsum nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ rin po che'i gdams ngag don bsdus rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin po che'i phyag rgya chen po/ tshigs gsum gnad kyi man ngag bstan bcos kun la phan pa rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ a'o rnal 'byor sangs rgyas la gdams pa/ e ma ngo mtshar rnam drug brgyud pa gser phreng*/ ri khrod pa'i gdams pa/ sems nyid rgyun chad med par nyams su blang ba/ dkon mchog gi 'khor lo ngur smrig gi mang ba/ bu shes rab 'byung gnas la gdams pa/ dpal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje a wa dhū ti chos kyi snying po sgom pa/ yan lag rtse ba sngon pa'i rjes 'brangs/ seng ge mi mjed sems kyi ting nge 'dzin 'ja' tshon/ 'bangs kyi zhu ba skyabs dkon mchog ma/ bdag nyid chen po'i zhu ba/ nor bu mkhan gyi zhu ba/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa/ slus dge ba'i nyin phyed so nam/ gsus po che/ 'ol dkar bskur ba/ dkar gtor phul ba la bskur ba/ lnga ldan dang zhag dang po/ lnga ldan me lce ma/ dug nad kyi dmigs pa/ mdor na dge bshes gcig la dmigs pa bskur ba/ dug nad kyi dmigs pa dang po/ gnas brtan gcig la dug nad kyi dmigs pa bskur ba/ dge sbyor la 'bad pa rten 'brel gyi chos/ mdor na dge bshes gcig la dug nad kyi dmigs pa bskur ba/

rkang pa gsum pa/ yum chen mo'i gnas/ bla ma rje btsun la gdams pa/ 'gyogs dang 'khrul 'khor gyi thabs/ khrag skyugs gegs sel/ jo bo chos sde ba la mig mchus byung ba la gdams pa/ ci byed chos dang mthun pa'i snyan brgyud/ dad pa gso ba gsang ba'i rnam thar/ babs kyi bcos thabs bla ma seng rgyal gyi zhal gyi mdzer pa sel thabs/ yon chen la jo bo thugs rje chen po yi dam du gnang ba/ yang jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas 'pho ba dang bcas pa/ sems gsum sa mtshams ma/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sgom bzlas/ khur chen thogs pa dbyer med/ rab tu dgyes pa'i dug sngags/ he he ku re kye ho/ dug sngags rgya bkrag gzan 'dzum/ lnga ldan zhu don gsal ba'i yi ge/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim gser 'gyur rtsi jo bo bla chen po la gdams pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs zab pa'i gnad kun nas bsdus pa sgom pa rang sgom la springs pa/ grib sel rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gdams pa/ dpal chen po la gdams pa/ rlung gi man ngag tshig rkang bdun pa/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo/ bla ma'i gdung sems nor bzang rnam thar/ bca' khrims ri khrod pa rnams la gdams pa/ brtag gnyis khams gsum ma/ dpal seng ge ye shes char yol/ 'jug pa sems nyid kyi gdams pa/ bde rang rang dga'i tshig rkang gsum pa/ mnyam nyid bka' stsal ma/ 'phags pa 'dod pa'i tshul khrims/ dge bshes gnyos kyi 'khor la gdams pa/ yin lugs gsum ma/ dge bshes sa skya ba la bskur ba/ rta 'chag steng dum ma/ bung ba me tog ma/ mtshan snyan bkra shis/ dgos pa'i mdo don rkang pa drug pa/ ma ga dha ji ltar chu la chu bzhag bstan pa gtad pa/ sems nyid mdo 'grel/ rgya mtsho'i chu rnams ro gcig bu la sbas pa'i gdams ngag rdo rje theg pa'i lde mig lnga ldan rtogs pa'i mgur/ tsha 'ug rdzong 'brom ma/ byang nam ra ma/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor thabs/ dpal rdo rje ye shes la springs pa/

drang srong chen po/ mar me'i sgom chen la gdams pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug dri ma med pa'i sgron ma shākya'i sras kyis zhus pa/ dpal ldan sgam po pa chen po'i mtshan la zur tsam bstod pa yi ger bkod pa/ yan lag bdun pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la springs pa/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi rang rang gi snying po phul ba/ rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ dge slong snying po blo gros kyis zhus pa/ nor bzang gi sems kyi sems bskyed/ che ba'i bdag nyid rje btsun gyis yi ge/ sems kyi 'dug lugs/ kun rdzob dang don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom lugs/ lce yon btsun la springs pa/ lta spyod zung du 'brel ba/ sgom pa chos skyabs la springs pa/ gnas lugs rdo rje'i gsang tshig snyan tshig gnad kyi man ngag nye gnas kyis bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par byed pa bya byed kyi rgya mtshor 'jug thabs ri khrod pas zhus pa/ rin po che'i thugs gzhan la phan pa/ lta spyod gnyis kyi nyams len/ snying por gyur pa'i gdams ngag bstan bcos gdung ba sel byed thugs kyi snying po/ ston pa'i khur chen dus gsum/ dge bshes lcags ri bas zhus pa/ rin po che'i thugs dgongs zab mo/ rje btsun rong pos zhus pa/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs/ rje rin po che'i phreng ba/ lta ba gser phreng*/ 'pho ba'i gdam ngag dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po/ yon bdag ge god la gdams pa/ ston pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba/ spangs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ bla ma lho pa char 'bebs pa la mdzad pa mthong lugs/ mi chos gnyis med zhi ba rang bzhin/ sgo slad pa mi yi seng ge/ reb ston rgyal mtshan 'bum la springs pa/ reb ston nye gnas mgo jo la springs pa/ yon bdag dbang rtse rgyal la springs pa/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i bka' stsal don gyi gnad dkrol shākya'i dge sbyong shes rab 'byung gnas la gdams pa/

'gran gyi do med sgom gzhon la gdams pa/ zung 'jug gsum gyi gdams ngag rgyal bas gang 'dod tshig rkang lnga/ rigs gsum bsdud pa'i thabs mkhas tshigs su bcad pa/ yab sras lnga yi gsang gtam/ skyo sangs su gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad 'thor bu phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa las de na med de 'di na yod rang rgyud smra ba'i mkhas pa/ bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod tshigs bcad/ sna byang ba'i e ma ngo mtshar/ brjod bya rjod byed spro byed dang bcas pa'i tshig bcad/ pha chos kyi rgyal po sogs tshig bcad gsum/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang rkang pa gsum/ lha dang bcas pa'i sogs tshigs su bcad pa/ ngur smrig rgyal sras sogs tshigs bcad gnyis/ rtogs pa'i mi la bskul 'debs/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa sogs tshigs bcad lnga dang rkang pa gcig legs par dgongs dang sogs rgad po tshul 'bum thugs rgyal/ lha na mo bcom ldan 'das sogs tshigs bcad gcig te bcu bzhi/ nga'i nye gnas 'khor dang yon bdag sogs tshigs bcad bzhi/ bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshigs bcad bzhi/ dge slong tshul khrims grags pa la gdams pa/ mkhan po khang gsar pa'i spyan sngar springs pa/ yin gsum 'jig rten gsum mgon/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung sogs tshigs su bcad pa/ chos byed snying nas byas pa'i khyad par/ 'phags pa'i sa thob pa'i tshul/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phags pa'i bskyed rdzogs nyams su len tshul/ bstan rtsis thub pa chen po/ spang gnyen gnyis med/ phag mo gru'i gdan sa na bzhugs pa'i dge bshes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gdams pa/ ma chos dpal gyi chos drug thabs lam/ srid pa kong rje drang dkar bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ gtum mo sum brtsegs kyi bsrung 'khor/ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la gtor ma 'bul tshul/ ston pa'i bstan pa dang rang gi spyod pa mthun rtags/

'ching ba'i thag pa gcod pa'i zhu ba/ til+li pas nā ro pa la gdams pa'i nyams myong zab mo'i don/ chos kyi rgyal po jo sing la gdams pa/ rje btsun gyi spyan sngar zhu ba/ gces pa'i snying po rin mdzod/ rje btsun ma la gdams pa don gyi snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud/ bu gcig shes rab rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ gang gis shing rdo khyer gzigs/ nye sde la bka' stsal pa/ sgom chen med bdun/ gnas kyi 'byung ba ro snyoms/ bu la snying gtam snying por gdams pa/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi bu slob la bca' khrims bskur ba'i yi ge/ dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa la gdams pa/ sgom chen thos ltos dris pa'i lan/ spyan snga rin po che la 'bul ba bskur ba/ gnad kyi snying po rgyal ba'i gsung rab dus gsum gsal byed/ phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas phan pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po/ gnad kyi snying po rgyal ba'i gsung*/ gdan sa'i slob dpon ri pa rnams der bzhugs par zhu ba/ phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga/ rnam thar rin chen phyag rgya me tog mi chos kyi mdun ma sa re si re bya ba/ slob dpon gdan sa pa la sogs pa rnams la zhal ta mdzad pa/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gcig rnams dril bas chos tshan brgya dang dgu bcu go gnyis/ mi chos gyi 'dun ma thugs kyi dpal be'u/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha rtsa pa rgya gar du 'gro bar bshol ba/ a mra'i tshal du dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes pa dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu/ mtho dman nyes pa sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang rkang pa gcig las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa dang sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa kho nas mkhyen pa lhag pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa sdig grogs dang nag po'i byas pa gzo ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dkar po'i las kyi spang blang la bslab pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis 'khor rab tu byung ba dang thag ring po nas 'ong ba/

dge 'dun la rab tu byung bar gnang ba thams cad mkhyen pa kho nas mkhyen pa/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa/ ko'u sham bi dbyangs can gyi kun dga' ra ba/ dge 'dun mthun par bya ba dang gso sbyong gi tshul/ tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po/ ma song sngar dad pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal/ bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i gnas mi zad lhun grub gter chen/ tshul khrims rin chen la gdams pa/ bslab pa gsum bstan pa/ shākyas zhus pa/ rang sems kyi gnas lugs bstan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po la gdams pa/ gsang ba phyag rgya chen po la gdams pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam gtan pa la gdams pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'phan po la gdams ngag sgro skur dang bral ba'i rkyen/ tsā rir bzhugs pa'i sgom chen la phung 'dre dang mkha' 'gro'i ngos 'dzin gsungs pa/ yang tsa rir bzhugs pa'i sgom chen la gong dang 'dra bar gsungs pa/ su zhig phung 'tsheng*/ lho pa char 'bebs pa la gsungs pa/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i thugs sras yon tan rgya mtsho skyes kyis zhus pa'i lan/ mchin pa khrag can pa spyod ngan gyis mdzad na shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag snying la yod pa gdams ngag tu gsungs pa/ zho gsum yan chod pa sogs kyi bca' khrims/ ngur smrig gi tshos bya thabs/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i phan yon lnga/ mig gzugs chags pa'i nyes dmigs mig gis gces sogs sho lo ka gcig bstan pa'i nyes pa rdzun gyi tshig nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa bcos dka' sla sogs kyi khyad par/ nyon mongs dang rnam grol gyi sems kyi khyad par/ bstan bcos glang chen rol pa/ gdan sa mdzad par gsol ba btab pa la 'ong gi gsungs pa/ ma yengs sgom pa/ byams dang snying rje smon pa dang tshul khrims gsum sgom pa/ gdan sa phag mo gru'i dge 'dun rnams la phra ba'i me tog phul ba/ nyams rtogs 'od zer drwa bas gdul bya'i pad+mo kha 'byed/

bzod shes gsum tshigs bcad gnyis dang rkang pa gcig lus ngag yid gsum 'ja' lus su bsgyur ba/ rang tha rgod 'dul ba/ sdug bsngal las thar thabs/ gsum tshan gsum pa/ sgom chen phyogs bcu ma/ sdod rtsis mi bya ba/ pha ltar brtse ba snying gtam tshigs gcig bde chen rdo rje/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug sgrub pa'i rten 'brel zab mo/ bla ma gnas nang pa sgam por 'byon par gsol ba btab pa/ zab pa bzhi yi dam chos rdo rje 'chang*/ gdung 'tshob bu sems tshig bcad/ bshags pa skyid du re ba'i phru gu/ zad pa bzhi yi dam chos/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i lung*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i spyan sngar zhu ba'i yi ge/ yang lan gsang gtam chen mo// zhe 'dod med pa'i brtul zhugs/ rten 'brel lnga/ gong ma'i rjes su rtogs drug dang gangs kha ba can drug bsngo ba mdor bsdus/ khyud gang la/ theg pa chung ngu so so'i thar pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal sing la snying gtam tshig gsum bshad pa/ rlung ltas tshig gcig phyag rgya chen po sgom tshul/ rlung ltas tshig bzhi/ kye ho ngo mtshar/ nyams len gsal ba'i sgron ma/ snying po don gyi gdams ngag bshus pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen jo sras kyis zhus pa'i gdams ngag phal po che'i bsngo ba'i lung*/ de bzhin dbyer med/ ba glang rkang gnyis/ u rgyan rgyal po 'dul ba 'dzin/ snying gtam tshig gcig theg chen gsang sngags/ mtha' bral rang sems/ rdo rje skyob pa shākya seng ge/ gnyis med bde ba chen po/ bstan bcos kyi rgyal po thabs snang ba'i me long*/ rang gzhan don grub/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba'i tshul/ ma rig nyes pa/ rang dbang ched bcu/ snang ba sems su shes pa/ byang chub gzhon nus 'dzin/ phyir drug rma bya gser du snang ba/ bla ma'i bstod pa tshig bcad ring mo/ byang chub sems me long bsam par bya ba/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las don dam pa tshangs par spyod pa'i kha 'dzin/ ri la 'gro ba'i bstan bcos/

ku res mkha' spyod gnas gshegs/ shrī phug pa'i bum pa'i thengs yig po po bkra shis rgyal mtshan la gdams pa ye shes rang grol/ bshes gnyen gzhon nu dbang phyug la snying gtam tshig tu brjod pa/ gar pa byang rdor gyis g.yu khang du zhus pa'i mgur/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan/ dga' zhing bde dang skyid pa'i thabs/ mi thub zla ba ku re kyal kha zur tsam zhu ba/ yod ma myong la khyad par chos/ nam ra ri bo'i zom/ 'khrul pa thar pa'i sbyor ba/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po/ 'phags pa 'char ka'i spong dgu spyod pa las gsungs pa/ lta sgom spyod pa gsum ya ma bral bar gnas pa/ skyur ra sgom pa/ bram ze'i rigs skyes/ spang blang gi gegs sel snying nas yin nam ku re yin/ bdud rtsi sa zhag lta bu'i tshigs bcad/ gshe bar mi 'os pa'i tshigs bcad/ nyes pa chos sku/ mkhas pa rnams kyi gdams ngag thub dbang nyid chen/ phyag chen rgyal chas/ ji ltar nam mkha' bya rjes/ zhe 'dod che la ngoms med/ rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa/ 'byung ba dus su/ ji ltar khams kyi ri khrod/ chad pa bcad par zhu ba bdag med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ snang ba zil gnon/ glang chung sa bar/ spos sna la bdug pa/ bdag gi bla ma bzang*/ nam mkha'i me tog sangs rgyas byon pa'i dga' ba/ khyi gzhug gad la mi btug 'dra ba bzhi/ bu+u zer ba bden no// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba/ chu yi rgya mtsho'i gdugs tshod kyi ting nge 'dzin/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa la springs pa/ don gyi snying po bsdus pa/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i 'das mchod/ phar phyin drug gi stobs drug so so'i las dang bya ba gru bzhi logs brgyad bcol ba/ dman pa'i byis pas nyams su blang rgyu'i thabs/ bde chen rdo rje rang sems/ kha dang bsam pa 'dzol na 'phags pas khrel/ rje rin po che'i byin rlabs/ mi gnas pa dang mi bya ba'i chos rnam pa bcu/

zhe 'dod kyi tshig rje rin po che/ skyu ra paṇa mo la springs pa/ bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i 'khrud shing nyams len gnad kyi man ngag chos kyi stan bshams pa'i phan yon bcu/ chos pa bzang po'i tshigs bcad/ bzhad gad rtsed mo/ lung 'di kun/ a tha ling sprang po sro shig mi gzhar/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu bzhi/ ka ra ra'i tshigs bcad/ dran dang shes bzhin/ sems nyid gnad/ a tsar+ya'i sgrub lugs tshigs bcad gsum/ yon tan 'byung ldan/ gsol 'debs 'jig rten/ 'khor ba myang 'das/ sgom zhes bya ba'i tshigs bcad/ sgom pa byang chub yon tan la gdams pa shing lo rlung khyer/ dus gsum tshigs bcad/ dam chos gleng slang*/ pha ri pha ri pha gir tshigs bcad/ 'bri gung pa'i longs spyod/ 'khor gyi bskor gsum/ tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sems khral chen pos thum phras/ rtag tu mnyam bzhag bka' dang bstan bcos la bla ma dgos par bstan pa/ snying gtam/ dga' bde skyid pa'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i gdams ngag lnga ldan du chos thams cad 'dus pas sgom par gdams pa/ lugs ldog lugs las byung ba'i rten 'brel/ byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsi/ mthong chos skyes na tshigs bcad/ rang gzhan don grub/ lha bdud du mi 'bab pa/ zad med gter chen/ rlung lnga'i gnas tshul/ thag chod drug pa dben pa bsten bzhi/ wa la za ma/ spyan ras gzigs la phyi nang gi bstod pa chos nyid 'khor lo/ bca' khrims/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gung pa la springs pa/ dge bshes ye 'od la sgom skyon phra mo bsal bar gdams pa/ thabs shes rab kyi gegs bsal ba/ nad drag po ma rungs pas yun ring du na ba la phan pa'i thabs dang po kho na/ dge sbyor byed mi byed kyi rim pa/ kha gdong las gas pa'i skyon 'dag thabs/ sku khams la phan pa'i dmigs pa/ grib sel/ nad sel thabs slu ba med pa/ bogs 'don bdag nyid chen po'i gsang gnas/ ban sde shes rab 'byung gnas kyis phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa/

bsod snyoms pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa/ rang byung byang chub sems kyi mthu stobs/ nyon mongs rnam rtog tshigs bcad/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis rtag par bya ba gdams pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog dge ba'i bshes gnyen grags pa dbang phyug la gdams pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ri khrod pa la springs pa/ dngul chu'i ri lu za thabs/ zab cing rgya che'i gdams ngag sgang ma sging thog gi man ngag sgo mang gi dkar chag sgo mang nang rdzongs kyi dkar chag rin po che'i phung po dri ma med pa/ nang rten sgo mang gi dkar chag chos kyi rje dpal ldan shrī ri phug pas bstod pa snyan ngag ka la ping ka'i dbyangs/ bla med nor bu'i gling*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ nges pa don gyi bstod pa ban+de shes rab 'byung gnas kyi yi ge/ ngo mtshar gyi bstod pa/ dbus su bzhugs shing yul du mi 'gro bar dam bcas pa/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ bkra shis rang byung*/ bka' brgyud kyi bkra shis tshigs bcad/ dug lnga rnam dag rigs lnga'i ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i bkra shis/ rten 'brel snying po'i tshigs bcad rnams sgril bas chos tshan nyis brgya dang sum cu so gcig go// de rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la chen po/ dwags po lha rje/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa/ chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ rdo rje rin chen/ nyer brgyad pa/ des kun rgyal ba la/ de gnyis char la/ nyer gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal pos/ de nas lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtsho/ chos rje rin chen dpal bzang po/ rgyal ba ma lus pa kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chos kyi rje rin chen rgyal po ba/ des bdag shākya dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po la'o//

//sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge sgra yi rnam 'phrul zhwa nag gi cod pan 'dzin pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i drung du rgyal ba gnyis pa 'bri gung pa'i dam pa'i chos theg chen bstan pa'i snying po thob pa'i chos tshan gyi rim pa ni/ thog mar rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam thar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bal bu gong pa'i rnam thar/ sa bcad de'i gzhung*/ 'grel pa/ gtam rgyud rnams cha lag dang bcas te thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ༈ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ rje phag mo gru pa/ chos rje 'jig rten mgon po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyas sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje rgyal po/ dharma rā dza/ slob dpon go bo gung pa/ rin chen dpal/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ sog dbon rig pa'i ral gri/ thams cad mkhyen pa mthong ba don ldan/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal po mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i rim pa ni/ dgongs pa gcig pa'i dkar chag de'i sa bcad/ gzhung*/ gsung bzhi bcu pa/ tshoms bdun yod pa las lta sgom spyod pa'i tshoms/ 'dul ba so so thar pa'i tshoms/ bslab pa byang sems kyi tshoms/ rigs 'dzin sngags kyi tshoms/ chos 'khor gyi tshoms/ rten 'brel gnad bsdus kyi tshoms/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i tshoms/ gtam rgyud rin po che'i phreng ba dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ rje phag mo gru pa/ chos rje 'jig rten mgon po/ dbon rin po che/ rgyal ba gcung*/ thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/

bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/ kun rgyal ba/ de gnyis char la dharma rā dza/ de la sman sgom 'od zer seng ge dang*/ bco lnga ba don grub rgyal pos/ de gnyis ka la ldong la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ des 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ des ngag dbang grags pa/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na 'jig rten mgon po yan gong ltar yin la/ de nas 'bri gung gling pa/ g.yor sgom pa/ zo yo pa/ ri khrod pa byams pa/ grub thob ar rtse/ nyer brgyad pa dang*/ mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/ dharma rā dza phyin nas gong bzhin no// yang na/ 'jig rten mgon po yan 'dra la/ de nas dbon rin po che/ gcung*/ ar rtse ba/ ri pa sher gzhon/ dharma rā dza/ sman sgom pa/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ de gsum ka la ldong la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de phyin gong bzhin no// yang na/ ar rtse/ nyer brgyad pa/ des dharma rā dza/ de phyin 'dra'o// yang na 'jig rten mgon po/ 'bri gung gling pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa shes rab grags pa/ dgongs gcig pa shes rab grags/ mkhan po rin rgyal ba/ dharma rā dza phyin 'dra/ yang na 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan snga grags 'byung*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ lo ras chos skyong dpal/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rin chen/ ri khrod pa/ ldong nam mkha' rgyal mtshan phyin nas gong bzhin no// yang na yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa/ ri khrod pa phyin gong bzhin no// yang rje de nyid kyi drung du skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i zab chos kyi khrid lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i chos tshan ni/ thog mar bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang chos byung tshul/ mos gus srog gi 'khor lo dbang khrid zhal gdams kyis brgyan pa/ bar do dgra bzhi lam khyer gyi gdams pa/ phyi sdom gsum gnad gcig

nang sdom gsum gnad gcig gsang ba sdom gsum gnad gcig yang gsang sdom gsum gnad gcig de kho na nyid sdom gsum gnad gcig 'bri gung pa'i zhu ba chos kyi sgo brgya pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor ba'i bsdus don bsod snyoms pa'i yi ge/ chos kyi 'khor lo gsum du bskor tshul 'ong ges zhus pa/ spyan snga 'bri gung gling pas mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs gsum ldan ma/ rten 'brel zhus lan ri chos gnad kyi man ngag zhwa chos rgol ba tshar gcod/ spyi don gnyis pa sems la gsum zhes pa bsre ba'i don khrid/ dka' srol bsre ba'i khrid yig don bsdu/ bsre ba gsum gyi don 'du/ rnam rtog gi rlung gnad du bsnun pa'i zhal gdams/ bsre ba zhal gdams mar grags pa'i don bsdu/ 'jig rten mgon po'i gegs sel/ rje spyan snga rin po che'i zin bris/ dang po lam du gtong zhes pa/ yang mgo'i tshig de dang 'dra ba la zhabs na dbang po ril bu shin tu bzang ba gnyis bskur nas rdog ces pa/ de la dmigs pa dang po zhes pa/ lam gtong la sogs pa sngon 'gro rnams mdzad nas zhes pa/ yang snyung gi lhag ma de dar cig sos par bya ba dang zhes pa/ dang po lam du btang de nas sems bskyed ces pa/ lam gtong yi dam lha dang zhes pa/ nan tan zhes pa/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam lha'i thugs zhes pa/ nad de'i dmigs pa zhes pa/ tshad ma'i dmigs pa zhes pa/ brgyud pa rin po che 'di'i chos zhes pa/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas khyed phyi rol du zhes pa 'di la dbon rin po che'i brjed tho zer ba/ gegs sel chen mo/ gegs sel gyi zhal gdams/ gegs sel sdug bsngal skem byed/ kun gzhi tshogs 'khor ma/ rten 'brel ri chos dang zab chos thor bu/ ma nges pa'i phung po la gnyis te zhes pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i zhes pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs/ spyir rlung sems dbu mar gnas pa zhes pa/

'jig rten mgon po rin chen zhal snga nas zhes pa/ brgyud pa 'di zhes pa/ dpal he ru ka yab yum gsang chen gyi sgrub thabs/ dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs/ e chung grangs can ma/ gtum mo sum khrid gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba/ dpal nā ro pa'i khrid rkang de gtum mo 'bar 'dzag yin zhes pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis zhes pa/ mchod pa rnams shoms shig ces pa/ gtum mo na tsha bogs 'don/ de'i gnad kyi gdams pa/ de'i 'phros/ rtsa tshig bsdus don nor bu'i phreng ba/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas tshe gcig lus gcig gi sangs rgyas zhes pa/ spyi chings bka' rgya ma/ lam tshogs pa gsum ldan/ skye ba de gdul bya sna tshogs 'dul ba'i sku zhes pa/ phyag chen a cig pad dkar gyi gdams pa/ 'dod chags dbang dang bsre ba/ zhe sdang 'pho ba dang bsre ba/ rnam par smin pa'i lus 'pho ba/ gti mug 'od gsal dang bsre ba/ tshangs par spyod pa thig le'i khrid/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi brjod bya rtsa rlung thig le gsum las zhes pa/ bsre ba zhal gdams nor bu'i phreng ba/ phyi yi ri chos gro lung ma/ nang gi ri chos gnad brgyad ma/ bsod snyoms pa'i yig chung*/ 'bri gung gling pa'i yig chung*/ ri chos gser khug ma/ ri chos bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ ri chos bdud rtsi'i gter chen/ gdod nas rnam dag spros pa'i mtha' dang bral zhes pa/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel gyi man ngag bla ma rin po'i zhal nas gdams pa 'di zhes pa bcu chos/ mgo'i tshig de dang 'dra ba gsum chos/ gsum chos 'khor lo ma/ phyi yi dpa' bo la dor/ nang la dor ba dpa' bo'i man ngag tshangs spyod las kyi phyag rgya/ phyag rgya bzhi yi rtsa tshig bsdus pa'i yi ge nyung ngu*/ gser khang sgo bcad ma/ de'i rgyab chos/ rtsa ba rlung lnga'i khrid/ bdud rtsi'i sgrub thabs/ zhi byed rmang lam ma/

'bri gung pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor/ yang zhal mnga' nas 'khor lo lnga po 'di zhes pa/ 'khor lo ma'i khrid/ sngags btsan thabs su ngo sprod par byed pa zhus lan bzhi pa/ yan lag rlung lnga'i khrid bsre ba zhal gdams ma/ yang 'khor lo lnga ma'i khrid cig bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal chen zhus lan/ yi ge gsum gyi man ngag 'chi ltas rmi lam du 'byung tshul/ byang chub kyi sems sprin gseb tu sba ba'i man ngag 'pho ba 'ja' tshon ma/ phyag rgya la brten pa'i rtsa rlung gi man ngag 'ur 'ded chen mo/ 'ur 'ded kyi zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ chos 'khor gyi tho yig nyams bzhi yi bcos/ sna rtse bzhi yi gdams pa/ 'khrul 'khor gangs seng*/ gtum mo'i man ngag de'i gdams pa lo rgyus/ chom rkun bcing ba'i gdams pa/ nyid kyi zhal nas lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis zhes pa dus drug gtum mo/ gtum mo 'khor spangs ma/ gtum mo phyi nang gsang gsum/ gtum mo na tsha bogs 'don/ pha rgyud yang snying sems snang ba gsum gyi sbas pa/ ma rgyud yang snying 'dod chags chos kyi sbas pa/ bdud bzhi'i bzlog pa sgom skyon bcos thabs/ rtsa gsum la brten pa'i zab chos/ 'tsho ba rgyun gcod/ rgyun gcod kyi zhal gdams/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gdams pa/ dmigs pa rdo rje shog dril/ man ngag them bu gzer thebs/ lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa gtso bor ston pa/ kun gzhi tshogs 'khor ma/ dpal chen zhus lan/ man ngag gi bstan bcos dri ma med pa'i phreng ba/ gnad bsre ba bskor gsum gyi don/ bde gshegs kyis mdzad pa'i man ngag bdun pa ri chos/ man ngag bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ sa ra has mai tri pa la gdams pa'i gnad bcu dgu pa/ bsre ba chos thun ma/ bsre ba'i gnad chos thun dgu pa/ 'khor lo bzhi yi man ngag tshangs spyod las kyi phyag rgya/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ drod btsan thabs su dbab pa'i gtum mo/ dbon rin po che'i tshogs chos/ rje yi gsung gi zin bris/

bsre 'pho'i rgyab chos/ phyag chen 'khrul pa rtsad gcod/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi skor/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi gnad kyi nying khu/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi zhal gdams/ snang ba rang sems bka' rgya ma/ thig le'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'phros rtsa rlung gi gnad/ 'pho ba 'ja' tshon ma/ dbon rin po che'i brjed tho/ dbon rin po che'i grib sel snel tshang ma/ dmigs pa'i stong thun/ nad 'don gyi zhal gdams/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i gdams pa bcu chos kyi rgyab chos/ sum chos kyi rgyab chos gnad kyi man ngag yang ri chos bdud rtsi'i bum pa rgyas pa/ snying gtam nyi shu rtsa gcig ma/ tshe sgrub yang gsang ga'u kha sbyor/ sgyu lus kyi gdams pa nags shod ma/ phyag mdud rten 'brel ma/ mdzo ra chos khri ma/ skyob pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgom thag gi rnam bzhag dpal nag po chen po'i gsang sgrub skor gsum/ dpal nag po chen po'i thugs sgrub/ dpal nag po chen po'i dam tshig thugs kyi sgrub pa/ 'bam thang bkra shis ma rnams yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li pa/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten mgon po/ dbon rin po che/ rgyal ba gcung*/ thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/ kun rgyal ba/ de gnyis char la dharma rā dzas gsan/ de la sman sgom 'od zer seng ge dang bco lnga pa don grub rgyal pos gsan/ de gnyis ka la ldong la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis/ de la 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis/ de la chos rje ngag dbang grags pas/ de la chos kyi rje dbang gis gsan/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la dgyes bzhin du gnang ba'o// yang lugs gcig la/ 'jig rten mgon po/ 'bri gung gling pa g.yor sgom pa/ zo yo pa/ ri khrod pa/ ar rtse ba/ nyer brgyad pa/ mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/

dharma rā dza phyin gong dang 'dra/ yang na 'jig rten mgon po/ dbon gcung*/ ar rtse ba/ ri pa sher gzhon/ dharma rā dza/ sman sgom pa/ don grub rgyal po/ de gsum ka la ldong la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis/ de phyin gong bzhin no// yang na ar rtse/ nyer brgyad pa/ dharma rā dza phyin nas 'dra'o// yang 'jig rten mgon po/ 'bri gung gling pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa shes rab grags/ dgongs gcig pa shes rab grags/ mkhan po rin rgyal ba/ dharma rā dza phyin 'dra/ yang na 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan snga grags 'byung*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ lo ras chos skyong dpal/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rin chen/ ri khrod pa/ ldong nam mkha' rgyal mtshan phyin 'dra'o// yang na yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa/ ri khrod pa phyin gong dang 'dra'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ 'jig rten mgon po'i chos drug gsar ma'i khrid yig cha lag dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag gru rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa gzhon nu rin chen/ chos kyi ri pa chen po/ nyer gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po/ chos rje don grub rgyal pos tshul khrims rin chen dang la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gnyis la gnang*/ de la 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis/ des mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa la/ des dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i yang snying gi bcud bsdus pa lnga ldan gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li nas/ 'jig rten mgon po yan spyi dang 'dra/ rje des sangs rgyas dbon la/ de nas rgyal ba gcung*/ thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/

nyer gnyis pa dang*/ don grub rgyal/ rgyal po ba gnyis char la lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtshos gsan/ des chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po la/ des dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la des bdag ā nan+da rat+na shrī bha dra la'o// yang na nye brgyud ni chos rjai 'jig rten mgon po phyin yin no// yang chos rje rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nā ro'i chos drug thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ grub chen u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rtogs ldan grags seng*/ sprul sku chos dpal bzang po/ rtogs ldan kun gzhon pa/ rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal po/ mkhas grub tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ des dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la legs par bstsal ba'o// yang na rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal pos/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ sprul sku chos dpal bzang po gsum ka las thob/ gong ma gnyis kyi khrid gnyer mdzad gsungs/ yang gong gi rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i chos drug gi khrid gzhung la chos rje chos grags rgya mtshos lung sbyor chen mo mdzad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po lha rje/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ grub chen u rgyan pa/ rje rang byung rdo rje/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rtogs ldan grags seng*/ sprul sku chos dpal bzang po/ rtogs ldan kun gzhon pa/ rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal po/ mkhas grub tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan/

chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ des chos rje rin po che dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ des rdo rje 'dzin pa ā nan+da rat+na shrī bha dra la bstsal ba'o// nye brgyud ni mtshungs med chos grags rgya mtsho/ des dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ chos drug rdo rje'i mgur/ ka dpe gong 'og gnyis// dpal ldan nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ rje sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal pa/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ maṅga la gu ru/ sangs rgyas dpal ba/ rat+na gu ru/ rat+na ka ra/ kun spangs chen po/ bkra shis dpal brtsegs/ byang chub rgya mtsho/ des chos rje ngag dbang grags pa la/ de la chos kyi rje dbang gis/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na la gnang ba'o// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ khyung tshang pa/ dngos grub rgyal po/ dbang phyug rgyal mtsho/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ kun ldan shes rab/ chos nyid dpal/ dbang phyug shes rab/ ri khrod pa/ gdan gcig pa/ la phyi ba phyin sngar bzhin no// ḍā ki ma ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid gzhon nu grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma/ skal ldan khyung po/ rmog cog pa/ sangs rgyas skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ chos grags dpal/ 'jam dbyangs pa ni zhabs/ mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rje rtsa ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje dbang rin po che/ de nyid kyis bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/

chos rje dharma rā dzas mdzad pa'i chos drug gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ dbon rin po che/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/ nyer gnyis pa/ don grub rgyal po/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag gi dbang po/ chos kyi rje dbang*/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bhi pa/ a la la badz+ra/ gar+bha ri/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes/ mi thub zla ba/ ye shes rdo rje/ 'brog mi/ snga ris pa gsar snying*/ sgyid chung 'khon sgra bla 'bar/ sa chen rje btsun rtse mo/ grags pa bzhis/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ bag ston pa gzhon nu/ tshul khrims/ gzhon nu mgon/ kun dga' dpal/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal bzang pa/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na 'phags pa nas/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal ba/ kun dga' dpal/ rgyal bzang pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje phyin gong bzhin no// yang na sa paṇa/ smar chos rgyal/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ kun bsod/ dpal ldan pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal ba phyin gong bzhin no// yang na kun bsod pa/ gan sa rin rgyal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal ba phyin gong bzhin no// yang rje de'i drung du/ phag mo gzhung drug sbyin bsreg dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lak+ṣiṃ ka ra/

bir+wa ba/ a ba dhū ti pa/ gdong ngar ba/ bsod snyoms pa chen po/ des sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ de ba ā kā rā/ ma hā bho dhi gsum la gnang ngo*// de yab sras bzhi khas bal po ha nu dkar po/ de nas rim pas dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ mnga' ris 'gro mgon/ lha rje ston pa/ dar ma bsod nams/ ko brag pa/ ri khrod dbang phyug thugs sras chos rje/ legs pa mgon po/ rdo rje bkra shis/ byang chub bzang po/ ngag dbang grags pa/ chos kyi rje dbang la/ rje des bdag ā nan+da rat+na shrī bha dra la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ klu yi byang chub/ shākya bshes gnyen/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ dza len dha ra/ ḍoṃ bhi pa/ be re ḍi pa/ mī ti pa/ ni ka lam ka de ba/ de wan tra/ chag lo tsā/ 'dzim pa rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ ye shes mgon po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gzhon nu mgon po/ kun dga' dpal/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang pa/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje dbang mnyam med rin chen rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpa' bzang po la'o// yang rje de'i drung du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud cha lag dang bcas pa/ dgongs pa lung ston le'u bcu gnyis pa lo chen 'gyur/ rdo rje phreng le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa lha zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur/ lha mo bzhi'i zhus le'u bzhi/ smṛ ti'i 'gyur/ ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa'i rgyud le'u gnyis pa nag tsho'i 'gyur rnams thob par byas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mtshur ston/ rgya lung phug pa che chung gnyis/ bar thang phug pa/ rgan ldan pa byang chub dpal/ skyor mo lung pa grags 'bum/

ye shes mgon/ seng rgyal/ gzhon nu mgon phyin gong bzhin no// yang rje de'i drung du/ rdo rje rgyan gyi snying po'i le'u bcu drug mjug tu bstod pa dang bcas pa/ lha ye shes mtshan gyi 'gyur thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ ma taṃ gi/ pak+ṣi ta de ba/ shākya shrī/ sa paṇa/ skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ lo mchog blo chen/ rgyal mtshan dpal/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ slob dpon rin rtson/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang ba/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje dbang rin po che/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po la dgyes bzhin du bstsal ba'o// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rim pa lnga'i rgya gzhung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi pa/ til+li/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon ston gad pa kīrti/ ja khang pa bsod nams rin chen/ thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ thang pe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sdengs pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od zer/ bu ston rin chen grub/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen grags rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rje ngag dbang grags pa/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na lo chen byang rtse yan gong bzhin la/ des chos rje bkra shis dpal brtsegs/ des chos rje byang chub rgya mtsho la'ang brgyud pa yod/ yang rje de nyid kyi drung du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i bshad rgyud rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/

sa pa ri/ dza ba ri/ de ba pur+ṇa/ lo tsā ba chos bzang dpal ba/ rton rin chen brtson 'grus/ smar chos/ mnga' ris skyi ston/ thur zla ba tshul khrims skyabs/ thang pe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gzhon nu 'od/ chos sku 'od zer/ lce blo ldan/ rje btsun pa/ bla ma dbang rdor/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ chos rje rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje mnyam med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na smar chos rgyal yan gong bzhin yin la/ des grub thob chos rgyal la/ de nas smar sgang phu ba shes rab rdo rje/ smar thub shes rab/ smar brtson 'grus seng ge/ 'jam dbyangs chos rgyal/ smar shākya bla ma rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ bu mang po ye shes grub/ 'jam dbyangs chen po phyin gong bzhin no// yang na grub thob chos rgyal yan 'dra la des dkar shākya grags/ bu lung pa/ grub thob u rgyan pa yab lung mang po grub pa dpal/ sras ye shes don grub/ 'jam dbyangs chen po phyin nas 'dra'o/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes dbang phyug ma/ las kyi rdo rje/ thang lo pa/ shing lo pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ wa la tsan+d+ra/ ras chung pa/ 'brog sgom/ zangs ri ras pa/ glu rings ras pa/ ras pa 'bum grags/ ba ser ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bya rin 'od/ blo chen/ bag ston/ gzhon nu mgon po/ kun dga' dpal/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang pa/ 'jam dbyangs chen po phyin gong bzhin no// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas par bam po gnyis pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs/ bho dhi satwa/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ sad na legs/ dar ma/ 'od srungs/ dpal 'khor btsan/ nyi ma mgon/ bkra shis rdo rje/ srong nge*/ lha sde/ 'od sde/ rtsel sde/ tshul khrims byang chub/ shes rab grags/

ston shaka bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas sgom seng*/ dkon mchog grags/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa byang sems bsod nams grags/ bsod nams bzang po/ gzhon nu mgon po/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ des chos kyi rje dbang rin po che/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rje rin po che de'i drung du/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i do ha skor gsum gyi gzhung gsum po thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' bde ba'i blo gros/ bram ze chen po/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ badz+ra pa ṇi/ mnga' ris jo gdan/ grub shul ba/ spar phu ba blo gros seng ge/ rgya sgom zhig po/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ rin po che brag 'bur ba/ ri pa gzhon nu rin chen/ bla ma dkon mchog rdo rje/ chos dpal shes rab/ rtogs ldan shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma smon lam dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang grags pa/ des rgyal ba ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dbang rin chen rgyal po la/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la'o// yang rgyal ba gnyis pa de'i drung du/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ bu ston gyis mdzad pa/ de'i zhal shes snyan thog pa don grub dpal gyis bskul nas/ rin nam pas mdzad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bu ston pa/ rin nam pa/ dpal 'dzin pa/ slob dpon tshul rgyal ba phyin 'og nas 'byung ba dang 'dra la/ yang na rin nam pa yan 'dra la/ des lo tsā ba byang rtse/ bsod nams seng ge/ slob dpon tshul rgyal ba/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dbang rin po che/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po la'o// yang rnam sras kyi lo rgyus man ngag thor bu dang bcas pa de'i sgrub thabs/ rnam sras kyi bstod pa/ dngos grub nor bu'i bang mdzod 'jam dbyangs chen pos mdzad pa rnams kyi thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/
