mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje dbang rin chen rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rnam sras kyi rjes gnang*/ bu ston rin po che nas brgyud pa'i sgrub bskor dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdo rje dang*// spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje kun tu bzang*// 'gro bzang snying po rin chen rdo rje dang*/ kha che dgon pa zangs dkar lo tsā ba// g.yor po jo gdan bsod nams rin chen dang*// pad+ma bkra shis rtag pa jo bzang pa// byams dpal lo tsā bsod nams dbang phyug dang*// bsod nams seng ge rin chen seng ge dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub// skad gnyis smra ba shākya bzang po dang*// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bla chen mañdzu shrī// bka' drin mtshungs med byang chub rgya mtsho'i zhabs// stag lung ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rin chen chos kyi rgyal// de nyid bka' drin kun dga' bdag gis thos// yang rje de'i drung du/ bka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer gyi lnga ldan/ de'i 'grel ba'i zin bris mkhas pa nor bzang gis mdzad pa dang*/ gsang spyod rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer/ dbon po byang chub bzang po/ chos rje rin po che ngag dbang grags pa/ mnyam med dbang rin po che/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpa' bzang po la'o// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ chos skyong ye shes mgon po'i rgyud mngon 'byung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub snying po/ ār+ya de wa/ a bha yā ka ra/ sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma jo tshul ba/ slob dpon sngags pa/ slob dpon mgon gzhon pa/

yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon po rgyal mchog bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang mtshungs med chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i chos skor thob pa'i thog mar/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos mdzad pa'i dpal nag po chen po'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i yig sna 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa'i zhal gdams/ nag po chen po'i dbang bzhi bsdus pa/ gtor ma'i byin rlabs dang bcas pa rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ slob dpon ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i dpal mgon po nag po chen po'i gsang sgrub/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bla ma a sing gis mdzad pa/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i phyi sgrub bsnyen pa'i man ngag dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa a bha yā ka ra dang rtswa mis bsgyur ba/ dpal nag po chen po la rtswa mis bstod pa se lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags pas mdzad pa/ bya rog gdong can la zhal gzigs dus bstod pa/ gsang sgrub rin chen gter mdzod/ man ngag sna bzhi dpal rga los rje phag mo gru pa la gdams pa/ gnod sbyin gang mdzes la brten pa'i nor sgrub pa'i man ngag dpal ye shes mgon po'i bsrung bzlog gi man ngag dpal nag po chen po'i sgo nas rang gzhan bsrung ba'i man ngag 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs dpal rga los mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes kyi rgya gzhung a bha yā ka ras mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang bcas pa/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ man ngag bsdus don dpal rga los mdzad pa/

yang lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag yang lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag tu bkod pa/ gtor ma'i rim pa de'i 'phros dang man ngag gi gnad/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ lhan cig skyes pa'i maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa/ gzungs chog bsdus pa/ za ba lha yi rnal 'byor/ nad gso ba'i gdams pa sogs rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag nas byung ba/ dpal nag po chen po'i gtor chen gyi cho ga cog ro chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ dpal mgon po'i sgo nas sre'u gso ba'i thabs/ thod nag gi sgrub pa rtswa mi chen pos mdzad pa'i gzhung nges drug ma/ las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong gi sgrub pa'i yig chung las sbyor gyi rtsa ba rtswa mis mdzad pa/ las sbyor gyi yan lag sbyin bsreg gi rgya gzhung*/ nag po chen po'i bsad pa'i las sbyor/ ngag mnan pa'i las sbyor/ nag po chen po'i cho 'phrul gyi man ngag nges drug ma'i gzhung gsal bar byed pa'i thod nag gi yig sna/ dpal nag po chen po bya rog gdong gi sgrub pa'i man ngag yang rtswa mis mdzad pa'i las sbyor gyi yi ge tshigs bcad ma'i gsal byed/ yang bsad pa'i las sbyor/ thod nag gi las sbyor/ yum tsan+ḍi ka'i sgrub thabs/ de'i lag len dang bcas pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i srog tig dpal nag po chen po'i las tshogs paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po las bsad pa'i mngon spyod/ rdo rje nag po las lus rengs byed kyi man ngag mngon spyod/ rdo rje nag po chen po las srid skem par byed pa'i mngon spyod/ rdo rje nag po las mngon spyod slar gso bar byed pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i mngon spyod kyi sbyin bsreg rdo rje nag po chen po'i las sbyor nyi tshe ba/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal mnga' nas brgyud pa'i man ngag ā bha yā ka ras mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags pas bsgyur ba'o// kha sbyor zhes pa thod nag gi bsnyen pa be'u bum dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa/

thod nag gi sgrub pa'i be'u bum dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa/ thod nag gi las sbyor gyi be'u bum dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i rkang brgyad 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta a ba dhū tī ba bai ro tsa na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba/ rtswa mis mdzad pa'i bstod pa se lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i bstod pa rtswa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags pas mdzad pa/ dpal mgon bya rog gdong can la dpal rga los zhal gzigs tshe bstod pa/ sku rags ma 'khor lo gnyis ma'i rgya gzhung*/ de'i khrid yig rgyas pa slob dpon mgon gzhon pas mdzad pa/ dgra bsad kyi yig chung zhal shes ma/ sku rags ma 'khor lo bzhi ma'i rgya gzhung dpal rga los mdzad pa/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i gzhung sgrub kyi mngon rtogs chos sdings pas mdzad pa/ yang de'i gtor ma'i gdams ngag srog sgrub zhag bdun ma/ dpal rga los ye shes mgon po zhal gzigs nas gsang sgrub tu mdzad pa/ dpal rga lo la ye shes mgon pos gnang ba'i shin tu gsang ba'i sgrub pa/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i tshe sgrub/ dpal chen po la ye shes mgon pos gnang ba'i gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa/ srog bzhi ma'i yig snying gsang sgrub kyi rtsa ba/ nang sgrub gnad kyi rtsa ba/ gnad bzhi ma'i rtsa ba srog bzhi ma'i yig snying las rgya brag kha ba chen pos cung zad rgyas par sdebs pa/ sku rags ma'i yig sna dang*/ gnad lnga'i man ngag dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa/ nag po chen po gzi mdangs bskyed pa'i man ngag tho yig tshigs bcad ma/ sngags kyi gnad drug zhes pa/ bris sku dang gtor ma la brten pa'i man ngag gces brgyad kyi gsal byed 'gro mgon gyis mdzad pa gnad kyi gzer them/ gces brgyad kyi rgyas bshad tshigs su bcad pa chos sdings pas mdzad pa/ dpal ye shes mgon po tshar lugs kyi be'u bum gsum pa/

gces brgyad kyi 'grel bshad chos sdings pas mdzad pa/ snang srid dbang du bsdud pa'i zhal gdams/ las mjug sbyin bsreg gi man ngag ma hā kā la'i rgyud thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pa ā bha kā ra dang rtswa mi gnyis kyi thugs dam/ dpal rga lo'i man ngag zhes pa/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs/ rgya gzhung*/ sku rags ma'i 'khor lo gnyis ma/ gtor ma'i cha lag dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub skor dang*/ yig cha spyi'i cha lag dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal chen rga lo/ bla ma a sing*/ dpal phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa bla ma mkhas pa/ chos rje maṅga la gu ru/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ rat+na gu ru/ ka drug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ dpal rin chen seng ge/ bla ma smon lam dpal 'byor/ chos rje ngag dbang grags pa/ chos kyi rje mnyam med rin chen rgyal po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpa' bzang po la'o// yang chos rje de'i drung du man ngag gi skor thob pa la/ thig le'i gegs sel thob pa ni/ kha zas kyi sbyor ba ngan pa sman dang 'gred kyis bsrung ba'i thabs yod ste/ thig le nyams pa dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ skyug pa dang*/ tshad pa'i nad kyis btab pa la sogs pa la bsrung bas mi thub pa lags/ rten 'brel gyi sbyor ba gzhan yang rten 'brel mi 'grigs pas bsrung bar dka' ba lags/ sngags 'di nga rang yid ches pas/ gnod pa bsrung bar nus pa lags pas/ dang po byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ sngags 'di la stong tsho gsum tsam yan ci mang du bskyal/ dal ba'i dus su yang ci mang du bzlas/ de nas yid mi ches pa'i kha zas dang phrad na/ dang por byang chub kyi sems dang yi dam kyi lha bsgom/

kha zas la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum bzlas la/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir dkar mer gyis gyur par bsam/ de la nyi shu rtsa gcig yan chad bzlas la/ sngags bzla zhing za ba ni bza' btung gi bsrung ba'o// khong du song zin na/ bza' rgyu dang*/ btung ba mtha' dag dang*/ chu la bzlas shing bza' btung bya ba dang*/ nad la shes pa gtad nas bzlas pa byas pas phan pa la tshegs med pa lags so// de'i sngags ni 'di'o// pe'i kro na/ bhi ha na/ bhas bha ba/ phu gang to to shi/ to ti bhis/ dza dzā/ kha gro gro/ kha gro gro/ dug se/ tog se/ sā+e to/ tod ci nan/ zhes so/ gu ṭu gu ṭu/ ma hā gu ṭu/ bharma/ biṣ+ṇu ma hā+e shwa ra/ gu ṭu/ ti ni de wa/ pe'u/ tsuṅge/ badz+ra gu ṭu/ badz+ra ke wa ra/ badz+ra bhā dong*/ da sha do wa ra/ bhū ru/ pre tu/ ḍā i ni/ ḍāṃ ki ni/ ku gya ni/ bi gya ni/ dzo ka re/ ku gya ni/ bi gya ni/ phi dri lā gha/ ta hi ka bhu kag ka ma dhu ki sa k+ṣa/ mau sidhi gu ru pā// ༈ //ra ga tā dza ṭā/ ra ga ta pa ṭā/ ra ga ta/ mu ka ta/ bā rba ṇi/ mu ha ra/ pā ṇi pā wa ta/ sarba do ṣa/ nī wa ra ṇi/ a la ṭad ti/ bhe da/ pā la ṭad ti/ kā yā/ rik+ṣa karan+ti ā di/ mī na/ tsa roṅgo/ shrī gho/ rak+kha/ rā yā// ༈ //ra ka ta/ ka la sa/ ta ga ta nā/ ḍi/ tuṇ+ṇa bhe de/ su ṇ+ṇa ka'i ni/ dze bhe te/ tai ma re/ u lu ḍi/ ya bhai da/ parta ha re/ ma hā yi la/ bhā da i/ a gya// ༈ //badz+ra aṅga/ badz+ra ka pā la/ badz+ra bha dong*/ da sha mo dwā ra/ u la ḍan+ti be dhe ya/ pa la ḍa ṇa ti kā ya/ ṭu na tā/ man dzin ka ro/ bai dha bi/ gya na dzin ka ro/ driṣ+ṭa/ muṣ+ṭi dzin ka ro/ ur+dha a r+dha phā ti 'dzin ka ro/ shrī gu ru su ra/ de wi ki i dz+nyi// ༈ //man+t+ra ka ri'i ti/ surti bhā do dzā pa/ dzā pa'i na'o na rī/ bha ha ta ri/ ko ṭha ra khong*/ ka le khe tra pā la/ dzo he/ ā ne/ mo he/ ā phi laḥṭa/ gha he/ saḥṭa/ mā ri/ mo re/ pā i ta le/ ā ni/ tsā pi/ ma hi/ ka li de bhi ke/ pu tra shrī ghor ṣanā tha/

ki ā gya/ u la ṭi bhe da/ te hi ka ro/ badz+ra dzo gi ni/ badz+ra ka wā ra/ badz+ri bha do/ dasde do wā ra/ badz+ri gho le/ pi we/ aṅge be dha/ bi gyan/ nā ra ha'i saṅge/ ka ma tu/ ka mak+ṣa shrī gho r+kha nā tha/ tu ma ri/ rak+ṣa/ be dha/ ba gyi/ dze ka ro/ ar+dha/ ur+dha/ phaṭ phaṭ/ shi re ma re/ ha na man+ta/ ki ra ki a gya phu re/ sngags tshan drug po de nangs par lto stong ngam/ gzhan du'ang rung*/ lag pa g.yas pa'i khyor chu la/ lan re'am gsum sogs bzlas te 'thung ba 'chag med du bya ba kun mthun no// u la ṭi bhe da gam+bhi ra'o/ bhan+dha bhan+dha dz+wa la bhan+dha u pa re/ tsa'u dha/ tā la/ he khre/ sa sad/ sa tā li dha te/ tho yi te/ a gri te tsā li te/ pa ṭa bhan+dha/ tsa'u pā sa ne/ shrī sa ka ṭa/ na ra sing ghe/ a ghi yi/ mo'u sidhi gu ru pā/ bdun nam gsum sogs snying khar gdab/ bsrung bzlog mchog go/ nang par langs ma thag bya'o/ ༈ /tshi tshi kā pa ṭa pa ni dong ba rging ṭhi nā du bā la de ṭe i ni bhu ta/ pre ta dzha kha kha dha na ba/ ka ha ro ni ha a dhi kar mau sid+dhi/ gu ru pā/ mi skra'i bsrung mdud la ci mang bzlas te btags pas byad dang*/ lha 'dre'i gnod pa bsrung ngo*// oṃ saṅku a ri bik+ṣa mā gha/ si bha sa bhe tso re bha ghe ḍa ma ḍa tu d+dho ba tsa/ rang gi rkang pa g.yon pa'i mtheb chen gyis ma tri 'drul zhing*/ sngags tshar brgya las mi nyung ba bzlas nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb chen gyi lto la sa de nas bgos la sngags ci mang btab nas/ un+ma di'i lā ḍar ti la ka bya'o/ ༈ /du yi/ de ghi par+haṃ t+na/ mā rdzeha ha sarba ri gaṅga ma ye/ a ghā ni/ khāng wa dzu rā wa/ a tha/ oṃ nga*/ bar ma/ gu ru a ghā ni/ mog su dhi// ༈ //de wa de wi kro mi dzā ni/ dza lan+ta a ghā ni ka rong pa ṇi/ gnyis kha lo ha ta ta ra kho ho/ na ma bud+dha ya/ da la khaṭ+ṭa/ da la khaṭ+ṭa/ da la siṅga sa na/ da la kha ṭ+ṭa/ da lo ka ran+ni ā san/ tad song ro/ ā kas+sa kā mi ni/

a ma ra ne tri phul pa ni/ shrī tsan+ḍa ki a gyem/ sngags 'di gcig nas gsum gyi bar// tshig pa'i sa la btab byas te// mig gi mtha' bskor la zhugs na// ling thog sel zhing zug rngu zhi// 'di 'dra'i man ngag khyad par can// sa yi mgon po ma gtogs pa// gzhan ni su la'ang med med 'dra// ka li de pi ka li ka aṅge pā ta la ka ye/ mo i su ts+tsha lo/ mor+pu ts+tsha kar+pa ra pe ṭhi kir brkar/ ka li ka tsan+ḍi ki a gye/ sngags 'di lan gsum bzlas byas te// chu ni hub gsum btungs gyur na// khongs kyi srin bu zhi 'gyur zhes// sa yi mgon pos de skad smra/ pud+bhe u le dzo ki ni/ pa k+ṣi ma ki ra an+da ra/ se dzo gi ni ki ban dum pa o/ sa ha sra dar/ dar ka ra a mo ka ang de khi bha hu ri dzā gar/ gaṇ+ḍa brni ni ba rni/ sa ha sra ra brni/ dar ka ra a ma ka ra ad de khi ba hu ri dzī gar/ a lo be ṭi he ro khaṇ+ḍa ki ni ba ro/ da re na hi ka ṭ+ṭe/ mo ne na hi phuṭ+ṭe/ shrī tsaṇ+ṭi ki a gyeṃ/ shrī raṃ ki a 'gyeṃ/ sngags 'di gcig gam gsum bzlas te// sa ni mang nyung ji tsam la// gtab te phu yis lus la reg /rdo rje bzhin du mkhregs pa'i lus// mtshon gyi 'big par mi 'gyur ba'i// man ngag khyad par 'phags pa 'di// mi lan na tha'i khyad chos yin/ bho mar bho mar/ bang sha shur/ bo mar/ ha ste ḍaṃ/ kan+de tsa mur/ tsa la bho mar/ mo hi man+ḍal/ da hi na bha n+dho/ da hi ni/ tsaur bhan+dho/ bi sho sha i ni/ an+ta pe ṭha bhan+dho/ gu ru ka shi ni/ shrī gu ru ki a gyeṃ/ tsau ra dha ra'i rig pa 'dir/ kho dza'i sa la lan gsum gtab// las la mi sbyor sa de dor// gson par 'gyur zhes rnal 'byor pa// sa yi mgon po de skad smra// smra bo'i gdams ngag rdzogs par mchis/ maṅga laṃ// ༈ //badz+ra kan+da'i sbyor ba la/ dkar po bcu dang nag po bzhi// ser po gnyis kyi bdag nyid can// zhib par 'thag pa shin tu gces// sangs rgyas bstan sogs gnod byed pa// 'joms par byed na khyad par 'phags// //

༈ //mkha' la 'phur ba'i man ngag la// zla ba bcu dang mtshan mo bzhi// nyi ma gcig gi bar rnams su// zhib par btags pa'i rgyags phye khyer// nam mkha'i lam la 'gro bar nges// the tshom med par myong bas grub// / ༈ //tshong 'dus rdo rje'i karma na// gser zho gsum la dngul zho bcu// lcags zho bzhi rnams mnyam zer te// lcags la snon pa cung zad cig /mnan na tshong la rgyal pham med// tshong pa bdag gis nyams su myong*// / ༈ //bya rog dgra bo cung zad ma nyams pa// ba dmar ri las byung ba'i chu 'thungs la// lung dmar gnyis gyi nang du khyod song la// gdung ma rgya gram 'og tu zla dgu sdod// de nas mi mngon nam mkhar 'phur bar bgyis// 'phur ba'i bya de srin mdzub shing la btags// dpral ba'i btson rwar bcings na legs par gces// / ༈ //ār+ya re/ nā ha rba ri/ twa hi tsa hri de kha u/ sā ta sa/ mu dra pā ra/ twa hi ma i/ kāṭ+ṭa u/ ba ra wa ṭ+ṭi/ p+pa ni pan+tha hwi dzā i/ skran nad byung na/ gang na sar gzhan zhig gi lag pas bzung*/ sngags tshar drug bzlas rjes/ sa la gri yis ri mo thur du gsum/ 'phred du gsum 'bri/ de yang tho rangs sam lto stong lan gsum bya'o// lu ki bar+yi ni/ be'u shin tu nag po skyes pa'i ba nag mo'i mar mang po/ zhum bu shin tu nag pa zar bcug pa skyug tu bcug pa'i mar la/ mar me bcos thod pa kha sbyar gyi nang du bcug nas/ khron pa'i nang du chud la ma reg tsam du 'jog de'i dreg pa dpral bar byug ā+o wu no' mu+on 'gra/ sā+o mu+on 'gra man thā bhai krā/ bhe krā mon trā rā/ bhai ra kha mā nā/ thā nā bhi ā lī/ sgra ra ra bhang khi ū+o sa hā sgrā yi/ rgā ra rgā ra/ pāng khi phā li/ pu hū?ng yi ā khi/ tsha dang bcas nas bskor ba'o// ༈ //ā+ong wung ī sha rā/ kā+e bho ī bhā lā/ s+hi yi/ phu hūng yī kā lā/ s+ho we thā+o/ 'di chu la 'debs par byed/ ā+o wung sbar ra ma tī/

bhā+e k+ṣi mā chā 'grā kā rā+o/ rdzā hā+e mī sgā phū bsrī/ īn 'ge ki ang sigā yā/ sa la lan gsum bzlas la gnam la sngags pas char 'chad par 'gyur ro// ༈ //ā+e īn 'grā ā ā+o/ rag sta bhā+ai wū/ bhā+ai kā+e mān 'grā+e ā ā+o/ gu ru kī sā kā tī/ mā+e ri bhi gā sti/ rel nag po byang la khrid/ de'i khrag dang sa bsres gnam la gtor/ chung mud gtor/ sngags 'di bzlas na 'bab/ yang ra dkar po'i khrag la/ spos dkar gyis bdugs te/ sngags 'di bzlas pas 'chad par 'gyur ro// // ༈ //a nā sgā+o/ pa ra ṭha ye/ pa bha ṇa nā tu ḍho ḍhi rtse ye/ phā sa kā rang*/ ḍhi hrī khrī yi/ trī blo wi kā nā tha/ tsa ṭur thā ya/ blo kha rtsag khye/ pang yā+e/ pra phā kha rā/ sa dha sā kī re ni/ khā sro me shra/ sā pā drod we/ ā s+hi s+hā nā/ ā stong wan nā wan s+hi s+he ne kar nā/ nā thā/ si rī su rī rdza d+ya/ s+he s+hā+o wan/ ā+e ka s+ha sī ru s+ha/ sā hā rang nā/ s+hū wa s+ha sī/ su rī rdzid+ya/ na wa ni/ rjā+e wi nā ra/ pa khrā dh+re/ nī rīng s+ha kha/ s+hā li s+hā/ bhā 'o na dri bha rtsā shi wi s+hī ra/ shir ri gu ru/ shā s+hi/ phā khi s+he wi/ zhes lan bdun bzlas pa'i g.yas pa'i sor mo sa la bkab nas kha la sbyor la bstan pas/ dgra rnams 'dun par 'gyur ro// nyi ma shar dus kha shar la bstan bzlas// ༈ //ā+en ta dan ta/ ba li/ uradz+dza/ mā su/ i tsā/ ri u bh+ra yi/ shrī gu ru a gya/ ha ma tsha ḍi ka hi/ na dzā i// dkar la thags bzang bla ma'i tshems// bzhi bcu'i grangs las mi nyams phyir// snga dgong thun du rig pa bzla// bzlas pa'i dus su tshems nem mdzad// mdzad pa tsam gyis phun sum tshogs/ kā ri nag po ma ḍi/ si a ser po a ri ma ḍi/ brah+ma tshangs pa'i bu mo ki be ḍa mi tshin+d+ra nya log ka li ga dzā so/ hi re gcig me ga sprin phaṭ+ṭi ral/ phuṭ+ṭi dum bu/

laṅga rgya mtsho'i pha rol pā ra/ shrī gu ru dpal bla ma'i bka' lung ki a gya/ sprin ni lho phyogs kha byang lta// de bzhin shar dang nub la'ang mtshon// rig pa gsum tsam bzlas pa'i rjes// sa sgong bzhin ni nam mkhar 'phen// de ltar byas na char pa phebs// chu 'dzin tshogs la sdigs mdzub sgreng*// rig pa bzlas pa'i rlung gis 'bud// nam mkha' dwangs par the tshom med// gnyis ka'i man ngag yin par mchis// gzhan la gsang ba dam tshig yin// ༈ //ā+o nga a'u sa tā/ kun ḍa li/ ni bā ti pa/ nā 'ā+e la/ bī ka lu/ she ya le/ pa ri/ nā ba/ ku ṇa ḍa la/ ma hā de wa/ se pa sta ya tsa ne le/ pan+tsa/ bhu ta ma a pa na ṭhā ye/ ba pā sa re a da gya na/ ma mā+e re a da gya ba 'di ni/ 'di ni a pā ne/ a dgyad/ ha te/ la ṭhi/ 'ga' la/ kan/ paṇ+ḍi prā ṇa sā+o ri/ na dzha ya/ nya tha/ as par ṇi as/ dharme sā ta/ sa ba da ka ri/ si as/ par ṇi as/ nangs par nam mkha' snga seng nas nyi dros yan la zla ba gcig dgong mo sa tshab tshub nas srod mgo yan la lan gcig ste nyin mtshan gnyis la thun bzhi bzhi/ thun re la chu tshod bzhi bzhi 'ong ba'i thun dang po gnyis kyi khongs su sngags tshan re'am/ gnyis sam gsum re gtan ma chag par bzla/ de'i tshe lag pa g.yon pa'i gung srin gyis/ rang gi lte ba mnan/ sha rjen la reg pa dgos/ g.yas pa'i gung srin gyis sa gzhi la bstan zhing mnan cing sngags bzla'o// lo bzhi'i bar du ma chag na yon tan ci rigs pa mngon du 'gyur/ de nas lo brgyad re bcu gnyis kyi bar du ma chag na/ tshe ring ba nad med pa/ yid la smon pa dang*/ ngag tu brjod pa son tsam yin pa/ 'grub pas te/ yon tan mtha' yas pa 'byung ngo*// dzo ki ma ni ka dh+wa ts+tshas byin pa'i a sha ma'o// ༈ //oṃ pā kā+e na/ phu s+hā+e wa/ nā pī rā kā re/ shā s+hā ku kī ri pa pā kī/ ā gyā phu rā+e/ dzo khe rtsa thu ngan thas byin pa'i gu na nga'i rtsa smuḍ+ga pa//

༈ //bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams grub mdzad pa// phrin las mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ya ma'i sngags la/ ya ni rgyan yin no// oṃ shāg ti nag po tshal par gas/ zhes ci mang ba grangs nas rang gi gzhogs gang na ba'i mtheb chen la gtab nas/ na sar drud/ gzhan sel nad gtad sngags byed cing*/ phus gtab/ gzer zug dngos su che ba byung na sel sla zhing*/ ma byung na gnyis gsum gtab pa gal che/ zab pa*// ༈ //yang ya ma'i bcos kha 'di la gsum ste/ phyi nas byug pa/ nang du sman gtong ba/ snar dud pas bdug pa'o// dang po byug pa byed pa ni/ gla rtsi/ mu zi dkar nag dang*/ bab bla/ ldong ros/ lang thang rtse/ ra dug spang spos/ bong nga nag rtsi bzhin btags la ra tshil lam/ rkang mar sbyar la na sar byug des ni zug de chog nas 'ong*/ khong sman ni/ 'o ma gla rtsi/ gu gul dang*/ shing kun shu dag sbyar te btang*/ dud pa la/ ra phag shwa tshil dag dang ni// thang phrom 'bru gu lang thang rtse// ra thug lug thug smra kha dang*// ra yi ra gzhob gla rtsi rnams// tshil bu gsum dang sbyar nas ni// ril bu ril ma che shos tsam// me la bsregs te dud pas bdugs// phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab bo// mgo dang rkang lag lus po la// ya ma ga nas 'khyug kyang rung*// mi bzod lhang khyog che ba dang*// rtsa la glog phran 'khyug pa 'joms// bsnyug gi byas la yang yang byug /dud pas bdugs la sman gtong byed// lag len dam pa mchog yin no// rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa khrag ya ma// de la sogs te ya ma srin bu'i rigs// thams cad la 'di las zab pa med// / ༈ //mkhal rtsa 'phral ba'i bcos thabs la/ rdzas dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ rdzas ni/ tsha bul med kyi rdog po la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags sum brgya bzlas nas/ spyin ne dmar po chag gas med pa'i nang chus bkang la/ sngags brgya rtsa re bgrangs nas/ chu phor gyi khar bskor zhing mthar chu nang du dor/

de yang nad pa'i kha'i steng du bzhag nas/ rgyab tu 'phang*/ sngags ni/ oṃ sarba ro kha li/ nad pa che ge mo/ a ka mi mdzā kha yo/ ces pa'o// dmigs pa ni/ rang gi mtheb mdzub bya khyung du bsgoms la/ gong gi las la 'jug gdams ngag ni/ bang che 'am sa la'ang rung ste/ zab pa'i phyir*// ༈ //char gcod kyi sngags la/ oṃ raṃ shag hung shag mdzā raṃ shag zhang ra shag phad raṃ shag ces pa/ rang thugs rje chen por bsgoms/ thugs kha'i me'i dkyil 'khor nas spros pa'i me lces stong gsum gang*// kha char phyogs su phus btab la// cha tsam bsres pa'i zan la ni// stong tsho gsum dag btab byas nas// nya sbal sbrul lcong gzugs bcos la// me yi nang du bsregs byas la// shing sna'i dud pas ches cher sbar// kha char chod par the tshom med// // ༈ //char 'bebs la rigs mang du yod kyang*/ 'di las myur ba med pa lags/ de la yang rdzas sngags sbyor gsum las/ tsha bul med thur ma gang la sngags 'di stong tsho gsum bzlas nas gdab bo// oṃ nā ga ra tsa/ ra dra ni hum̐ hūm̐/ phu phu zhes pa'o// gsum pa ni/ rdzas de nyid dang por sho gus btums/ de zan gyi sbal pa'i khog par bcug nas chu mig klu gnas nges su sba/ zhag gsum tshun char 'bab bo// ༈ //drag 'bebs la/ gri khrag dme khrag mdze khrag yugs sa ma'i mngal khrag gtsod khrag nya/ sbrul/ sbal pa/ sdig pa/ sdom gyi sha rnams dang*/ bse zho rnams snyug tshigs nang bcug de yang snyug ma sbom po'i sbubs su kha la cha dang*/ spra tshil gyis bcad/ de yang yugs sa'i skras bcings lugs mthong ba brgyud pa ltar byas la/ chu mig klu gnas nges kyi mgor phur btab la/ de la btags nas rdzas chu nang du 'jog des ni char 'bebs thub nges shing*/ char bab byung 'phral snyug tshigs bsdud pa gal che'o// char 'bebs gang la'ang*/ rlung gnon zab mo byed pa gnad yin no// // ༈ //yang rnal 'byor pa mi snang bar 'dod na/ lug thug nag po'i sog pa'i bal dang*/

gzhung de nyid las bsdus pa'i dbang chog gi lag len rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ dharma rā dzas mdzad pa'i bstod pa rin chen las grub/ nyer brgyad pas mdzad pa'i in+d+ra nī la'i khang bzang ma/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bskang yig nor bu'i phreng ba/ yang bskang yig chung ba/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i mngon rtogs bskang yig dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma/ a mes tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ g.yung drung rgya mtsho/ nam mkha' dbang phyug pe ka dbang rgyal/ bsod nams dpal/ ka thung gru bzhi/ mkhan po dar ma/ dkon mchog rin chen/ btsun pa 'bar/ yab rnal 'byor pa rdo rje/ chos rje 'jig rten mgon po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ waṃ rin po che rin chen dpal gyi rgyal po/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mnyam med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o// de ni nye brgyud do// yang na ring brgyud ni chos kyi rje nyer gnyis pa/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ sman sgom 'od zer ba/ des la phyi ba nam mkha' rgya mtshan la/ des 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ des chos rje ngag dbang grags pa la/ des mnyam med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ shin tu nye brgyud ni/ dz+nyā na ḍā ki'am/ a phyi chos kyi sgron mas/ mnyam med chos kyi rje dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ lhan cig skyes sbyor nged rang gis bsgrigs pa 'di thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ dpal til+li pa/

nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ rje phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten mgon po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ gshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ mnyam med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud rnams la yongs su grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams kyi bstan bya mthar thug pa/ grangs su bcad pa grub snying gi bskor rnams dang*/ grangs su ma bcad pa la ni bsam las 'das pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i rgya gzhung legs par thob par byas pa'i rnam grangs ni/ dpal gsang ba grub pa pad+ma badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab pa grub pa/ ye shes grub pa/ gnyis med grub pa/ lhan cig skyes grub/ de kho na nyid grub pa/ gsang ba'i de kho nyid grub pa dang bdun la grub pa sde bdun du grags pa dang*/ snying po bskor drug la do ha mdzod ces bya ba sa ra has mdzad pa/ phyag rgya bzhi rjes su bstan pa zhes pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong ār+ya de was mdzad pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag slob dpon tog tse bas mdzad pa/ dbang bskur nges bstan zhes pa mai tri pas mdzad pa/ gnas pa bsdus pa zhes pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dang drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor nyi shu rtsa drug gi lo rgyus/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lta ba ngan sel/ zung 'jug gsal bar rab tu bstan pa in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad pa/ do ha di zhes bya ba gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba/ rin chen phreng ba'i bshad pa/ yid la mi byed pa ston pa'i lo rgyus nyung ngu*/

yid la mi byed pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dran pa zhes bya ba gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dbang gi mdo bsdus pa dang*/ dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa dang*/ dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa slob dpon mai tri pas mdzad pa/ thabs dang shes rab lnga pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar bstan pa/ lhan skyes drug pa/ dbu ma drug pa mi phyed pa lnga pa/ dga' bcug lnga pa/ bde chen gsal ba/ de kho na nyid bcu pa/ de kho na nyid rab tu bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya rnam par bshad pa/ rdo rje sems pa'i rang bzhin lnga pa/ bde chen gsal zhes pa dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa/ shes pa spro bsdu med par 'jog pa'i man ngag gsang ba dam pa/ phyag rgya bzhi yi rim pa rin chen snying po/ bka' bskul gyi chos bzhir grags pa las dbang bskur nges bstan gyi 'grel pa rā ma pha las mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i tshig badz+ra pā ṇis mdzad pa rnams so// sgom rim drug pa/ snying po de kho na nyid rin po che'i 'od ces bya ba nā ro pas mdzad pa gdams ngag rin chen 'bru gu shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ de nyid sku 'da' khar nam mkha' la byon pa'i tshigs bcad/ rdo rje slob dpon mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga rgyas par byed pa/ thig le grub pa'i bsdus don ye shes grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes grub/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa slob dpon chen po dzā lan+dha ra pas mdzad pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i lo rgyus/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i lo rgyus/ lta ba rab tu mi gnas pa'i lo rgyus/ rmi lam gyi lo rgyus/ rmi lam nges par bstan pa/ sgyu ma nges par bstan pa'i lo rgyus/ sgyu ma nges par bstan pa/ theg chen nyi shu pa'i lo rgyus/ theg chen nyi shu pa/ de kho na nyid gsal ba'am bstan pa'i lo rgyus/

de kho na nyid bstan pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dbang rnam nges kyi sa bcad/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan lhan cig skyes pas mdzad pa'i sa bcad/ mi phyed pa lnga pa'i sa bcad/ cho ga rgya bzhi'i sa bcad/ phyag rgya lnga'i sa bcad/ rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar ston pa'i sa bcad/ lhan skyes drug pa'i sa bcad/ theg pa chen po nyi shu pa'i sa bcad/ de kho na nyid nyi shu pa'i sa bcad/ yid la mi byed par ston pa'i sa bcad/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba'i sa bcad/ slob dpon badz+ra pā ṇis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig la sogs pa'i sa bcad/ rdo rje phag mo la a wa dhū ti pas zhal gzigs kyi bstod pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ de'i dka' 'grel gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa/ do ha dang rdo rje'i gsung sogs las/ sku yi mdzod 'chi med rdo rje'i sku/ gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i glu/ thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po rnams bram ze chen pos ra has mdzad pa/ phyag rgya chen po 'chi kha ma'i gdams pa/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag sa ra ha'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis kyi bshad pa/ sa ra ha'i ka kha'i do ha/ rtse mo do ha'i glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ nag po rdo rje zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i do ha/ de'i rgya cher 'grel pa 'od dpag med kyis mdzad pa/ dau ha mdzod kyi dka' 'grel gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ do ha mdzod kyi dka' 'grel thar pa'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ zad mi shes pa'i gter mdzod yongs su gang ba'i glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ til+li'-i do ha/ yang do ha mdzod ces bya ba bi ru pas mdzad pa/ chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par ston pa/ de kho na nyid kyi tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi 'grel pa a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa/ dngos po skyob pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab byed ār+ya de was mdzad pa/

ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ snying po kun las btus pa'i rab byed ā nan rab byed kyis mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi grub pa bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa sa ra has mdzad pa/ sems brtag pa tshul khrims 'phags pas mdzad pa/ man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa sa ra has mdzad pa/ dngos po'i gnas lugs sgom pa nor bu gling pa bde ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod gcod pa pas mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu gsal ba thub pa byin gyis mdzad pa/ klu sgrub kyi tshigs su bcad pa phyed dang lnga pa/ phyag rgya bzhi yi man ngag gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal ldan nā ro pa'i glu tshan gnyis/ lhan cig skyes pa'i glu zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ rnam rtog spangs pa'i glu li la pas mdzad pa/ gtum mo'i do ha mdzod kyi glu bi ru pas mdzad pa/ dpyid kyi thig le do ha'i glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i gdams pa mi dhi nis mdzad pa/ bla med sbyor ba'i rim ba slob dpon baṃ gas mdzad pa/ lta spyod skye med kyi gdams pa slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa/ skyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rtsa ba sgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon ni la kha dhas mdzad pa/ phra ba'i rnal 'byor slob dpon sa mu dras mdzad pa/ rang bzhin gyi do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba lu hi pas mdzad pa/ lta sgom spyod 'bras do ha'i glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ do ha mdzod kyi de nyid kyi glu slob dpon kar+ṇa ris mdzad pa/ spyod pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu slob dpon kang ka nas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba slob dpon bha dras mdzad pa/ bde gshegs kyi lta ba'i glu slob dpon dharma pas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid do ha'i glu slob dpon ma ti pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje bzhi yi glu a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa/ bla ma mai tri pa'i glu/

sa ra ha'i glu/ yang sa ra ha'i glu/ bi ru byed pa'i glu/ kar+ṇa ri pa'i glu/ ma tri tsakra'i glu/ 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar zhes pa'i glu/ bdag ni 'dug ste shi yang ma shi med ces pa'i glu/ ār+ya dpa' bo rnam par snang mdzad kyi glu/ nā ro pa'i glu/ lu hi pa'i glu/ ḍoṃ bhi pa'i glu/ bi ru pa'i glu/ lwa ba pa'i glu/ ma hā su ka ta'i glu/ rnal 'byor pa lnga'i glu/ klu sgrub kyi glu/ di paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na chos kyi glu/ na ni skye med 'chi med ces pa'i glu/ do ha spyod pa'i glu yi lta ba slob dpon ki ta pas gsungs pa/ stong nyid lta ba sha ba ri pas mdzad pa/ bde sdug lta ba slob pa shin+ti pas mdzad pa/ 'brel med kyi lta ba slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi lta ba slob dpon dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ spyod pa'i glu slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis gsungs pa/ spyod pa'i glu'i 'grel pa dpal mar me mdzad kyis gsungs pa/ chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i glu dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ rdo rje gdan gyi glu mar me mdzad kyis gsungs pa/ rdo rje gdan gyi rdo rje'i glu yi 'grel pa dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid sgom pa'i man ngag tho ra gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs rim bi na pas mdzad pa/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba slob dpon tsa ma ris gsungs pa/ rang gzhan grub pa med pa bzhi'i man ngag klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rin chen phreng ba si la a lis mdzad pa/ snying rje sgom pa'i man ngag til+li pas mdzad pa/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag slob dpon dho khan tis mdzad pa/ sems la gros 'debs/ a dzu kis mdzad pa/ gzhi lam 'bras bu sgom pa phyag chen po'i nyams len slob dpon pi ka las mdzad pa/ rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa ḍoṃ bhi pas mdzad pa/ yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ḍoṃ bhi pas mdzad pa/ de nyid bde ba sgom pa'i rjes su 'breng ba'i man ngag ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/

sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i thabs slob dpon mo ko las mdzad pa/ lta ba kun gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lam gan+dha ri pas mdzad pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgom pa ra hu lhas mdzad pa/ rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len slob dpon tsam pa kas mdzad pa/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtogs pa'i snying po slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ thugs kyi gsang ba glu ru blangs pa/ grub thob pho mo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ thig le dag pa'i phreng ba/ grub thob bzhi bcus rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa/ thig le gser gyi phreng ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa lnga'i rtogs brjod mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod na gnas pa las dbyings kyi bka' bgraus nas rje dam pa rgya gar ba la gnang ba/ mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jam glu ring mo/ rnal 'byor thams cad kyi de kho na nyid gnang ba zhes bya ba grub pa thob pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur le'u dgu rje dam pa rgya gar gyi rang 'gyur/ phyag rgya chen po gser phreng zhes bya ba grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos gsungs pa rnams mai tri pas gzhung gcig tu sdebs pa'i gdams pa/ shes rab kyi spring yig slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i rtogs pa'i gegs sel sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ dug lnga sbas pa'i lam chog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa byang chub rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shes rab tsam pa dus kyi gtam zhes pa gnyis med rdo rjes bram ze bha lo la gdams pa/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u mar me mdzad kyis gsungs pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bud+dha shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag shākya shrī dras mdzad pa/

sems rin po che sbyang ba'i lam 'bras bud+dha shrī bha dras gsungs pa/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag shrī dz+nyā na mi tra ā nan+das gsungs pa/ grub pa dam pa'i lam nges pa rang gi sems kyi mdud pa grol ba'i gdams pa/ bshes gnyen drug gi don du gsungs pa/ phyag rgya chen po chos spyod kyi do ha/ dpal bde chen grub pa slob dpon ko las gsungs pa/ na mo bud+dha'i 'grel pa/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems ngal gso bar byed pa'i man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu lnga pa zhes bya ba de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i do ha/ rtogs brjod sum cu pa mi tra dzo kis mdzad pa/ shin tu spros pa med pa de kho na nyid kyi man ngag bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag bdag byin gyis rlob pa ri khrod pas gsungs pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ri khrod pa'i gsung*/ byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ go bar byed pa'i snying po brgya pa slob dpon ār+ya de was mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas 'char ba lu hi pas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid grub pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu 'byed pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ sems kyi lam sbyong zhes bya ba ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i man ngag badz+ra pā ṇis mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid 'jug pa zhes bya ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' ma lus pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon ye shes grags pas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa slob dpon chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa/ tshul gsum gyi sgron ma slob dpon mtho btsun tri pi ta ka ma las mdzad pa rnams thob pa'i grub snying dang*/ yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor nyer drug rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ nā ga pa/ sa ra ha/ mai tṛ pa/

ni ru pa/ dbang phyug tshul khrims/ snul dge 'dun 'bar/ mi ston dran chung*/ dran ston mtha' bral/ me ston kun rin/ lha chos kyi grags pa bkra shis/ sras shākya dpal/ kun mkhyen 'dzam gling pa/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ bla ma chos dpal/ chos rje grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na ni ru pa yan gong dang 'dra la/ des mi snyon rdzong pa/ dam pa lha rjes/ jo dbang*/ gcung chos dbang*/ dbon shes dpal 'gro ba'i mgon po/ de'i gcung grub chen pa/ kyi byams pa/ puṇ+ya nā tha/ nam mkha' 'od/ 'gro ba'i mgon po/ badz+ra dhi da dha/ grub chen pa/ bsod nams byang chub 'dzam gling pa/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal ba/ chos rje grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ mi pham mgon po/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ bhi la badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ lcam la k+ṣiṃ ka ra/ dha ri ka pa/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma tsi to/ ka ḍa ḍi ba/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mkhan chen skye chu ba/ sa skya ba yab sras gsum/ khu dbon gnyis/ bla chen bag ston pa/ bla ma dkon mchog pa/ bla ma chos dpal ba/ chos rje grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ de phyin gong dang 'dra'o// yang na blo gros rin chen/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa phyin nas gong bzhin no// yang na ni ru pa yan 'dra la/ de nas/ kyi mgon po/ kyi byams pa/ kyi bsod nams mgon po/ kyi nam mkha' 'od/ kle'u rgya gar mgon po/ badz+ra sid+dh-i/ bsod nams byang chub/ 'dzam gling ba/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ bla ma chos dpal ba phyin gong bzhin no// yang na rgya gar phyag na yan gong bzhin la/

des bal po a su/ dgang ston 'od 'bar/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mi snyon dran/ dran ston mtha' bral/ me ston kun rin/ lha chos grags/ bla ma shākya dpal/ 'dzam gling pa/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ bla ma chos dpal phyin gong bzhin no// do ha ni mi zad pa'i rmang do ha'i gter mdzod/ yongs su gang ba'i glu zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpa' bde ba'i mgon po/ sa ra ha pa/ mai tri pa/ grub thob ka to pa/ kor ni ru pa/ badz+ra hri rat+na pa/ rgyal ba'i sras nas brgyud de/ dkar chang mi sding ba/ 'bras dkar ba/ ngams shod rin chen/ thang tshul khrims mgon/ bla ma mgon rat+na badz+ra/ bla ma chos dpal ba/ de phyin gong bzhin no// sa ra has mdzad pa'i rgyal po'i do ha/ ka kha'i do ha zhes bya ba sa ra has mdzad pa/ rtse mo do ha'i glu zhes bya ba sa ra has mdzad pa/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ sa ra has mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ byang sems bde ba'i mgon po/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ de gnyis ka la bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang*/ klu sgrub gnyis kyis gsan/ des sha ba ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ mnga' ris jo gdan dharma shrī la/ grol shul ba dharma kā'irti/ spar phu ba blo gros seng ge/ khams pa glang ston/ gros mo grags pa/ rin po che 'bras dkar ba/ bla ma ngams shod rin chen/ bla ma tshul khrims mgon po/ bla ma dkon mchog rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal phyin nas gong bzhin no// til+li pa'i do ha mdzod kyi brgyud pa ni/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ dz+nyā na kīrti/ zhang tshal pa phyin gong bzhin no// yang rje de'i drung du/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa/ de'i 'grel pa/ rngog pa'i zin bris chen mo/ rngog pa'i bsre 'pho'i gdams pa'i pod lung*/

dpal stag lung pas mdzad pa'i zin bris bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal nas stag lung pa la brgyud pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sbas don kun gsal lhan thabs dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro gur gyi rgyud/ sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i lung*/ sgra ka lā pa'i bstan bcos/ rtsis lnga bsdus dang gza' lnga'i gzhung*/ po to ba'i dpe chos/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa/ spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa/ stag lung pas mdzad pa/ mdo sde rgyan dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi gzhung rnams kyi lung thob pa'i rgyud pa ni ma chod/ gzhan yang rbad 'dre rbod stong bzlog pa'i gcod dmigs stag lung pa nas brgyud pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgyas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa gang blo ma/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon paus mdzad pa'i gtor ma cha bcu phyag khrid lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rgyal sras til+li pa/ mkhas pa nā ro pa/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ chos rje zla 'od gzhon nu/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal po/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po mtshan mchog rin chen dpal bzang po/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ gcung rdo rje grags pa/ rgyal sras thog kha ba rin chen seng ge/ mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod nams/ bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen/ nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal po/ nyer gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ ldong la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o// yang nye brgyud kyi dbang du byas na rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bdag nyid kyi bar du'o// rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba des// rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*/ 'jig rten mi shes gti mug rab bsal nas// mthar phyin sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog

maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun 'dus pa'i// mkhyen brtse phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa las// karma pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mgon khyod spyi bos 'dud// ces pas mchod par rjod par byas nas/ sems can gyi khams dang bsam pa dang mos pa sna tshogs pa la dgongs nas/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las par dbang bskur ba thob pa/ zhwa nag gi cod paṇa 'dzin pa rgyal ba bdun pa chos kyi rje don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na chos grags rgya mtsho'i dpal zhes pa'i dam pa gnyis pa de nyid kyi drung du/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i dam pa'i chos thaig pa chen po bstan pa'i snying po thob pa'i rnam grangs brgyud pa dang bcas pa ni gong du gsal ba ltar yin la/ kar lugs rang gi lhan cig skyes sbyor nyams khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ rje sgam po/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pa/ dge 'dun 'brum/ rang byung ba/ grags seng ba/ de gnyis ka la ri khrod pa mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la rol pa'i rdo rjes/ des mkha' spyod dbang po la/ des de bzhin gshegs pa la/ rin chen bzang po/ mthong ba don ldan chos dpal bzang po/ dpal 'byor don grub/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ rje des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na ni phyag rgya chen po rgya gzhung ltar brgyud dgos te/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ blo gros rin chen/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pa/ u rgyan pa/ rang byung ba/ g.yung ston pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rig pa'i ral gri/ mthong ba don ldan/ des 'jam dpal bzang po/ des chos grags rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o// yang na mthong ba don ldan yan 'dra la/

mthong ba don ldan gyis dpal 'byor don grub la/ des chos grags rgya mtsho la/ des bdag la'o// yang chos rje de'i drung du/ yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chog khrigs rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud rim ni/ bde gshegs pa rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal sras til+li pa/ mkhas mchog nā ro pa/ mar pa lho brag pa/ dbang phyug mi la/ mnyam med sgam po pa/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pa/ mkhas grub u rgyan pa/ chos rje rin po che/ rgyal ba g.yung ston pa/ rang byung ba/ mtshungs med mkha' spyod dbang po/ thub chen chos rje/ rig pa'i ral gri/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o// gar dbang bdag po rgyal ba kun gyi rigs rje dang*// mkha' mnyam stobs bcu mi 'jigs ma 'dres yon tan rdzogs// bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba gnyis pa chos kyi rje// zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i dam pa gang khyod spyi bos mchod// ces brjod nas/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag gi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar bzung ste gdul bya skal pa dang ldan pa rnams yang dag pa'i lam du bkod de 'dren par mdzad pa/ mtha' yas pa'i gnas dang gnas min gyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul du ma ston par mdzad pa/ khams gsum gyi bla ma mnyam pa med pa'i dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan smos na/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po zhes grags pa gang de'i drung du/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung gdams pa sogs thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ thog mar gnyis su med pa dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dang po sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ lha dbang*/ gzi brjid can/ zla bas sbyin/ lha yi dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/

lha yi dbang ldan/ rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ bzang po rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen/ bzang po phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang*/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal ka/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong*/ dpal skyong*/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ nā lan+d+ra ba/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung*/ sgros ston rnam lha brtsegs/ grub chen yum mo/ sras dharma shwa ra/ grub thob nam mkha' 'od/ se mo che nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ bla ma chos dpal bzang po/ sku zhang chos rje rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ gzhung pa yon tan dpal/ slob dpon rin po che/ bla ma rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang skur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ snying po zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting 'dzin bzang po/ rin chen bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge/ rgya shes rab rin chen// chos rje grags don ba/ chos rje byang dpa' ba/ dpal byams pa gling pa chen po/ chos rje lo chen/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na ba ri ba yan 'dra ba sa skya pa chen po mchims thams cad mkhyen pa/ mchims glo gtan/ mchims chos seng*/ lce mdo sde/ rong pa dga' lo/ shes rab seng ge bsod nams lhun grub/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ dpal ldan legs dbang*/ brag nag pa bsam gtan dpal/ lho brag pa dpal ldan bzang po/ mkhas pa rin chen mchog ldan/

slob dpon rin po che bla ma rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang gdams ngag gi skor la/ rngog lugs la rdzogs rim gyi lam srol thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa ba bsre 'pho 'am/ rim pa lnga ldan du grags pa'i skor gyi pha rgyud ma rgyud thun mong ma yin zhing*/ ma rgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang las dgyes rdor skor gyi man ngag du'ang 'gyur la/ rngog lugs la dgyes rdor gyi man ngag gi bka' gzhan med pas/ 'di nyid la mdzad de de dag gi chos skor thob pa ni/ khrid kyi rtsa ba thun mong gi zhal gdams/ zhal gdams bka' bzhi'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ steng sgo rnam par grol pa'i gdams pa/ a thung tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ dbang nyams/ phyag rgya chen po/ gnyid 'od gsal/ 'byung bzhi ro snyoms/ kha sbyor dbye ba'i yig chung*/ 'od gsal don bzhi ma/ grong 'jug 'pho ba grong 'jug gi zhal gdams/ phyag rgya chen po snang ba phyi shun/ dgra bo gsod pa'i yig chung*/ sbyangs te 'pho ba zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gtum mo gegs sel/ las rgya'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa/ sgyu lus bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ bar do'i gdams ngag dka' ba bcu gnyis rnams kyi lo rgyus sogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ lwa ba pa/ mkha' 'gro ma skal pa bzang mo rnams rje til+li pa'i bka' babs bzhi yi bla ma yin la/ de nas nā ro chen po man ni brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa rgyud lugs dang 'dra'o// yang na rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa nas/ bla ma sang yon pa/ āḥhūm̐ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ de la rin po che byang chub dpal bas gsan te/ brgyud pa lugs gnyis 'gre'o// yang gsang gnad kyi 'pho ba'i man ngag sbyor ba drug pa'i bye brag dag ces sogs kyi man ngag ba'i nu ma dang chu shing me tog sogs kyi man ngag gsang gdan gzhung dang sbyar ba/

mchod rten bum pa'i man ngag yang dag lta ba'i gzugs can kyis zhes sogs dang sbyar ba rnams dang*/ ba glang rmig pa'i gdams pa dang*/ chu shing me tog gi gdams ngag la phyi nang gsang ba/ de kho na nyid bzhir phye ba rnams mar pa'i gsung rgyun thun mong ma yin pa rnams te/ mar pa nas rim gyis brgyud ste/ rin po che seng ge dpal ba la bzhugs pa la/ byams pa gling pa chen pos gsan/ de la chos kyi rje lo chen gyis gsan/ des chos rje zhwa dmar ba chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po la/ des bdag la kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o/ /dbyings kyi rnal 'byor gyi man ngag dang*/ 'khor lo sngags dang rnal 'byor gyi man ngag gnyis slob dpon zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ yang 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ rlung bum pa can la bslab pa/ thig le la bslab pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ rlung 'ching ba/ khu ba 'ching ba rnams kyi zhabs na/ de ni puṣ+pa ha ri ba'i man ngag ste/ slob dpon zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa zhes yod pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ dhū ti pa/ chos kyi bzang po/ zhi ba bzang po/ mar pa lo tsā/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog kun dga'/ rngog gzi brjid grags/ rngog rin chen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sangs yon pa/ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra/ rngog byang chub dpal ba/ rje btsun kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje lo chen/ chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstsal ba'o// yang chos rje nyid kyi drung du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis su med pa khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/

til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ rje sgam po pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa phyin nas lhan cig skyes sbyor dang 'dra'o// yang rje rin po che de'i drung du/ sku gsum dril sgrub kyi man ngag thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med/ o rgyan rin po che/ mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal/ karma pa thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje/ zhwa dmar ba grags seng*/ chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje chos dpal ye shes/ chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ba'o// de ni nye brgyud kyi dbang du byas pa yin no// pad+ma tshe dpag tu med pa'i tshe sgrub thun mong ma yin pa thob pa'i ring brgyud thun mong ma yin pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje/ mnyam med rtogs ldan blo gros/ drin can ri pa kun dga'/ rigs 'dzin shākya grags pa/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstsal ba'o// yang rje de nyid kyi drung du/ bde mchog lu hi pa'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon lu hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ ka tsa tra pa/ lam ka ling pa/ tsār+ya pa/ gu h+ya pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ ma ni ka shrī/ mi thod ha ra phu/ pham mthing pa/ su ma ti kīrti/ mar do/ de phyin 'og nas 'byung ba dang 'dra'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni/ lu hi pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ lwa wa pa/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ ka tsa tra pa/ gā nā pa/ dzā lan+dha ri pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa pa/ ku shi kra pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/

ma ṇi ka shrī/ bar po bi dhan+ta/ mar pa do pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gze ba blo ldan/ gze ba bde mchog rdo rje/ la yag pa byang chub dngos grub/ rgya thams cad mkhyen pa/ dge 'dun 'bum/ rang byung rdo rje/ mgon rgyal ba/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon bsod sing ba/ dkon rgyal ba/ slob dpon rin po che bla ma rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnang ba'o// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ khrid skor thob pa la nā ro chos drug gi zin bris chen mo/ de'i lud sbyor chen mo/ zab lam chos drug gi mngon rtogs gsang gnad yid bzhin rgya mtsho/ nges pa'i man ngag gsang ba 'dus pa/ tsan+d+ri thun sbyor gyi yi ge gzhung ji lta ba lam du byed pa'i khrid/ don bsdus pa'i lung rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ bla ma chos bzang ba/ sprul sku chos dpal ye shes/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ba'o// yang na mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ rin chen bzang po/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ sprul sku zhwa dmar ba chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang rje de'i drung du/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ de phyin gong bzhin yin/ yang rje de'i drung du sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sgam po pa yan spyi dang 'dra la/ des dwags po skyer ston pa ye shes rdo rje/ des mtsho maṇ+ḍal nag po'i nang du gter du sbas pa de nyid kyi skye ba phyi ma la ni/

dung mtsho ras pa te mtshan shes rab rgyal mtshan 'am/ rin chen bzang po zhes pas gter nas gdan drangs nas/ 'khrul zhig chen po la gnang*/ des sna phu bya bral ba rdo rje mdzes/ des chos dbyings dbang phyug des gtsang pa blo bzang pa/ des rin chen dpal mgon bzang la/ des sprul sku chos dpal ye shes la/ des bla ma gu'i gung pa/ des chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po la/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rje de'i drung du/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum gyi lung thob pa'i rnam grangs dang bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni gong du gsal ba ltar yin no// yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ gser sdings pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid yig gdams phran la pha rgyud yang snying gi khrid yig ma rgyud yang snying*/ rim lnga don khrid/ don lnga ma/ gdan rdzogs 'khor lo can/ 'khor lo med pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs/ mnyam bzhag sgyu ma/ rmi lam sgyu ma/ bar do sgyu ma'i man ngag sku gsum gyi 'pho ba/ btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba/ rnam shes grong du 'jug pa'i man ngag srog rtsol la brten pa'i gtum mo sgom pa'i man ngag 'khor ba 'jug ldog la brten nas ma rig pa rtsad nas gcod pa'i gdams pa/ 'og sgo la brten nas bde ba lam du byed pa'i man ngag bsre ba drug gi man ngag 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul/ rdo rje sems dpa' gseb lam sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag rmi lam la brten nas sgyu ma btsan thabs su gzung ba'i man ngag snying kha mi shigs pa la brten nas rig pa rtsad nas gcod pa'i man ngag rim lnga cig car ba'i man ngag gsang ba thugs rgyud kyi man ngag rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ma tiṃ gi pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/

mar pa/ tshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ bya khang pa bsod rin/ thur zla ba tshul khrims skyabs/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ chos kyi 'od zer/ 'phags 'od/ bu rin po che/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba skyabs mchog byang sems nam bsod/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpa' bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ bde mchog gi bshad rgyud mngon brjod bla ma/ le'u drug cu rtsa dgu ma/ lo chen dang chos brtson gyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma'i kun spyod mar pa do pa'i 'gyur/ yang khrag 'thung mngon byung le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa las chims yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri pa/ lu hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ ghan+dha pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dzā lan+dha ri pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ 'bar ba'i slob dpon zhabs/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ sa chen pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa/ 'u yug pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ dharma sras/ dharma dh+wa dza/ gar thig pa/ chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med de'i drung du/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa ra ha/ mai tri pa/ ti phu ba dang gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ chos rje karma pa chen pos grub chen u rgyan pa la gnang*/ des chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ phug mo che ba gsod rin/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig pa/ bla ma grags pa 'od zer/ slob dpon rin po che/ bla ma rgyal mtshan/

sprul sku chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med de'i drung du/ phyag chen yan lag bdun pa zhes pa'am/ rnam dag sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu'i ngo sprod bka' ma'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro chen po/ mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ mi la ras pa/ rje sgam po pa/ karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/ de phyin sku gsum ngo sprod kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje rin po che de'i drung du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ rat+na shrī/ ka l+ya na/ shan+ti ba ma ti/ sa ti da ba ra/ bh+ya mi shrī/ shong blo brtan/ lo mchog bde ba can ye shes mgon po/ seng rgyal ba/ gar thig pa/ mkhan po shar rdor ba/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags rdor ba/ grags don pa/ rin po che byang chub dpal/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ bde mchog sdom 'byung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lu hi pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ dha ra na shrī/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā/ tshur dbang nge*/ spug thams cad mkhyen pa/ spug dharma nye du/ bya rin chen 'don/ bla ma sangs rgyas sras/ slob dpon rin po che/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag nyid chen po spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga zhes bya ba gur rigs bsdus su grags pa lha zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob par byas pa'i brgyud pa ni/

khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ mgon po klu sgrub/ mkha' 'gro ma skal pa bzang mo/ slob dpon lwa ba pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lho brag pa/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ dam tshig rdo rje grags/ bka' lung gnyen sgom/ mnga' ris pa byang chub tshul khrims/ rgya pho ba lung pa/ bla ma rgyal po dga'/ rngog seng ge sgra/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rngog don grub dpal/ rngog byang chub dpal ba/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gdan bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' lha dgu bcu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ dge ba'i go cha/ go cha'i sde/ rnam rgyal dbang po sde/ tha chung pa/ rje mar pa/ rngog chos rdor/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ kun dga' rdo rje/ gzi brjid grags/ rin chen bzang po/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ don grub dpal/ rngog rin chen byang chub dpal/ chos rje lo chen/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ rje btsun mar pa/ rngog chos rdor/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ rgyal tsha ra mo/ rngog tsha chos sku/ rngog tsha dkon mchog dpal/ dran ston mtha' bral/ dran ston shes rab bzang po/ man lung gu ru/ man lung pa kun mkhyen/ 'dzam gling sang rin/ tshul khrims mgon/

rin po che byang chub dpal ba/ chos rje lo chen/ sprul sku chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du chos kyi rje de nyid kyis dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa/ de la nā ro pa dang*/ zhi ba bzang po/ mai tri pa gsum kas gsan/ nā ro pa dang*/ zhi ba bzang po gnyis ka la rje mar pas gsan/ des rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ rngog kun dga'/ rngog gzi brjid grags/ rngog rin chen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rngog don grub dpal bzang po/ rngog rin chen byang chub dpal ba/ chos rje lo chen/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ dus gsum mkhyen pa karma pa'i thugs dam lnga tshan lngar grags pa'i nang nas bde mchog lhan skyes lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ thang lo pa/ shing lo pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ gzhon nu rin chen/ shar dgon pa/ kun dga' 'od zer/ yor pa ye shes dpal/ ston pa chos rin/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// yang na ni nye brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje til+li phyin gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ //yang chos rje de nyid kyi drung du/ rngog lugs dgyes pa rdo rje rigs bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs gsung rgyun ji lta ba'i zin bris dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gsung rgyun ji lta ba'i zin bris/

rje mar pas mdzad pa'i gur gyi srog shing dang*/ bshad rgyud las kha bkang zhing rngog rin chen bzang po'i tho yig dang mthun par chos kyi rje lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa dang*/ gdan bzhi yab bka'i sgrub thabs gsung rgyun ji lta ba'i zin bris/ slob dpon ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i snying po mdor bsags dang*/ rnam rgyal dbang po'i sde'i dgongs pa gtso bor byas te lho pa dkon mchog dpal gyis byas pa'i yig cha rnams la brten pa'o// gdan bzhi yum bka' lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i yig cha bshad rgyud sbyar ba/ gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog bshad rgyun dang man ngag lugs dmigs phyed par byas pa'i gsung rgyun ji lta bar bsgrigs pa'i zin bris/ ma hā ma ya lha lnga'i mngon rtogs gsung rgyun ji lta ba/ ku ku ri pa'i gzhung la brten nas zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa dang mthun par ngag 'don klag chog ma hā ma ya lha lnga'i dkyil chog gsung rgyun ji lta ba'i zin bris/ ku ku ri'i cho ga'i rim pa gsal bar brten pa/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil chog rngog lugs ji lta ba'i zin bris/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i sgom 'bum la brten pa rnams kyang*/ rje lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes mdzad pa ste/ de rnams kyi lung rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun lo chen spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ bde mchog lhan skyes lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa byin rlabs dpal 'bar zhes bya ba/ de'i mchod phreng*/ ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba de'i cho ga rnams kyi lung dang*/ snying po skor drug las/ dmangs do ha sngar gsan/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi gtan la dbab pa/ tog tse pas mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa/ ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i sems kyi sgrib sbyong*/

slob dpon de wa a ka ras mdzad pa'i shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bde ba'i mgon po/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ ti phu pa/ ras chung ba/ bur sgom nag po/ phag mo gru pa/ rgya log phug pa/ gser sdengs pa/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od pa/ bu ston pa/ rin nam pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen ma hā lo tsā/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //phyag rgya chen po grub pa sde bdun du grags pa la/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra nas/ rnal 'byor ma rtsi ti'i bar gyi bdun po 'di snga ma snga ma'i slob ma phyi ma phyi ma rnams yin zhes bu ston rin po che la sogs pas gsungs te/ de yang slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i gsang ba grub pa le'u dgu pa/ thabs dang shes rab grub pa yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rim par phye ba le'u lnga pa/ ye shes grub pa le'u nyi shu pa in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad pa/ lo chen dang shra dha ka ra warma shrī bha dras bsgyur ba las nag tshos bcos pa/ gnyis med grub pa lcam la k+ṣiṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes grub le'u gsum pa ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas mdzad pa/ u rgyan nas byung ba'i gsang ba chen po'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i don de kho na nyid grub pa rnal 'byor ma rtsi tos mdzad pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sha ba ri pa/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ de la slob ma dbus gtsang gi mi bdun te/ brang ti/ grab kyi 'o brgyad ston chung*/ stag tshal gyi zhang lnga ring mo/ ba reg thos pa dga'/ bra bo 'bum pa 'bar/ dge bshes she'u/ rong pa shes 'dri/ mi rnams las phyag la zhabs tog che tshad bsod nams che bar byung ste/

ba reg gi gser phul gyis bcal nas snga ma la 'khar gzhong gang*/ phyi ma la zangs gzhong gang phul/ ba reg sems phyogs la mkhas pas grub snying la mkhas pa/ she'u tshogs la mkhas gsungs so// brang ti la gtsang yang dag 'bar/ phug bzung skyabs/ gtsang 'byung seng*/ lce ston mdo seng*/ bla ma ston shag lce blo ldan seng ge/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ rin nam pa/ grags rgyal ba/ mi dbang grags pa 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //snying po bskor drug gi gzhung drug tu grags pa la/ sa ra has mdzad pa'i dmangs do ha/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi gtan la dbab pa/ tog tse pas mdzad pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa/ ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i sems kyi sgrib sbyong*/ slob dpon de wa a ka ras mdzad pa'i ye shes gsal ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bde ba'i mgon po/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ ti phu pa/ ras chung pa/ bur sgom nag po/ phag mo gru pa/ rgya log phug pa/ gser sdings pa/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od pa/ bu ston/ rin nam pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen ma hā lo tsā/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang de rnams las do ha mai tri pa'i slob ma rgya gar phyag na/ de'i dngos slob nas brgyud pa lugs gnyis phyogs 'dir 'byung ste/ de la stod lugs ni/ ba reg gtsang shod pa/ snar ston ne rings/ lha rje ston dngos/ rje btsun sman nang ba/ spyang khung phur ba/ rgya log phug pa yan gong bzhin no// rmangs lugs ni/ bal po 'bum me/ bal po bde chen/ slob dpon ston shag chos sku 'od zer mgon phyin gong bzhin no// yang rje de'i drung du/

phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa'am/ yang na sa ra ha/ mai tri pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pa/ gnyan ras/ rang byung rdo rje/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ bsod nams 'bum/ slob dpon bla ma rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ lam 'bras dpe mdzod ma thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog shākya ye shes/ se 'khar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa skya pa/ 'gro mgon rin po che/ 'jig rten mgon po/ rje spyan snga ba/ rgyal ba gcung*/ bcu gnyis rin po che/ slob dpon bsod nams dbang*/ spyan snga grags pa shes rab/ slob dpon tshul rgyal ba/ spyan snga grags 'byung pa/ spyan snga kun spangs pa/ chos rje grags 'byung ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa gzhon nu dpal/ des spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po// des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ thugs bskyed chen mo thob pa'i brgyud rim ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ rgyal tshab byams pa/ slob dpon thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ rnam grol sde/ grol ba'i sde/ bai ro tsa na/ rat+na bha dra/ gser gling pa/ dī baṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ rab mchog sde/ yol chos dbang*/ dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa/ yang na jo bo rje/ rgya yon tan grags/ mnyam med dwags po/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ rang byung rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ des thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o//

༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang lung sogs cha lag tshang bar thob pa'i brgyud rim ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas rjes su bzung ste/ ngag dbang grags pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ dge bshes ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ dge bshes rwa sgreng pa/ rje dwags po lha rje/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ bla ma ba li pa/ slob dpon tshal pa/ slob dpon shākya gzhon nu/ rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge/ mkhas grub dar rgyal ba/ chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po/ bla ma bsod nams 'bum/ slob dpon rin po che/ bla ma rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa/ yang na rje btsun ma sgrol mas rjes su gnang ste/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra/ paṇa chen dā na shrī la/ tsan thang bla ma ka lā pa/ rtogs ldan rin po che grags seng man chad gong bzhin dang*/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba la chos rje mkha' spyod dbang pos/ des chos dpal ye shes/ des thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po la/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ dpal nag po chen po byin rlabs mgon po phyag drug pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pa paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī dang*/ rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ bha ro/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rga lo/ rwa sher rgyal/ blo chen pa/ bde ba can pa/ gar thig pa/ mkhan chen sher rdor ba/ chos sgo ba/ grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa/ 'bri gung mkhan po/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma chos grub seng ge/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //dpal nag po chen po'i le'u brgyad yod pa paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba phur bu 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa dpal mgon po nag po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/

'phags pa nag po chen po'i gzungs/ rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pra dz+nyā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'gyur byang med pa/ dpal lha mo'i bstod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud las brgya byin gyis dge bcu'i sgo nas bstod pa/ rnam sras kyi lam lnga'i bstod pa/ mi'am cis gnyis su med pa'i bstod pa/ dri zas phrin las kyi bstod pa/ klus yon tan la bstod pa/ grul bum gyis sku gsung thugs la bstod pa/ thags bzang ris kyis don dam la bstod pa/ nam mkha' lding dang lha bran dang gshin rje'i che ba'i yon tan la bstod pa/ bram ze mchog sred kyis kun rdzob bden pa'i bstod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī bha dra/ mgar lo tsā ba/ glan ston shes rgyal/ dbas byang sems dmar ston/ ye ston dar ye/ chos dbang*/ blo mchog blo chen/ gar thig pa/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ chos sgo ba/ grags don/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa/ 'bri gung mkhan po/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma chos grub seng ge/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ma'i rgyud kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ rngog ston chos rdor/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog kun dga'/ rngog gzi brjid grags/ rngog rin chen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rngog don grub dpal ba/ rngog rin po che byang chub dpal ba/ rje btsun kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje rin po che lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi pa spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje nyid kyi drung du/

bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra gyis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ sngar 'gro ba'i mgon po'i 'grel pa dang lhan cig thob pa lo chen gyi brgyud rim ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ma rin chen rdo rje/ bram ze skal ba bzang po/ bram ze ḍiṃ gi pa/ pra dz+nyā badz+ra/ sta shod shākya seng ge/ lo ston rdo rje seng ge/ gan pa ston dar/ pra dz+nyā ma ti/ dharma te dza/ dharma rat+na/ rat+na dh+wa dza/ thog ston shin rdo rje/ bla ma bde legs pa/ rnal snying mkhan po rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma chos grags pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ smar ston chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje lo chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ des bdag la cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ba'o// ༈ //bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas// lhun grub byang chub chen por thugs bskyed cing*// lam tshul sbyangs pa mthar phyir dge ba'i bshes// bla na med pa'i dam pa la phyag 'tshal// sngon gyi dus su zla 'od gzhon nur gyur// lnga brgya'i dus 'dir mtsho byed rgyal po dang*// da lta'i tshe na shrī dbang rat+na zhes// rnam 'phrul gsum du ston mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// byams pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa dang*// snying rje'i rtsa ba brten pa'i sngon mthu las// lhag bsam byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs shar// yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag skyongs shig /ces dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus shing*/ sgrib gnyis mun pa'i dmag rum thams cad gsal bar mdzad pa/ bden pa gnyis kyi don bstan pas lus can mtha' dag gi mig brnyes pa'i dam pa bla ma rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa'i zhabs kyi drung du chos thob pa la/ zab lam nā ro chos drug chos kyi rje nyer gnyis pas sgrig pa'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang chen po/ til+li/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis rin po che/ nyer brgyad pa/ nyer gnyis pa/ don grub rgyal po/ sman sgom pa/ de gnyis char la ldong ston pas/ ldong ston la 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis/ des mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa de la slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pas/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang chos kyi rje de'i drung du gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ klu byang*/ zla ba grags pa/ ku sā li che ba/ ku sā li chung ba/ gser gling pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ sa ta na/ btsun mo can/ mngon shes can/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ sdong nyi ma seng ge/ nyi ma lcam/ ye shes seng ge/ rin chen grags/ tshul khrims skyabs/ 'phags pa skyabs/ gzhon nu 'od/ chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ tshul khrims snying po/ grags pa rin chen/ nam mkha' tshul khrims/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba/ des bdag la'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ klu yi rnal 'byor ma/ bi su kalpa/ sa ra ha pa/ klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ tshur ston dbang nge*/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ bya sga ba bsod nams rin chen/ thur zla ba tshul khrims man 'dra'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ thugs rje chen po dmar khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thugs rje chen po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub thob tshem bu pa/ byang chub 'od/ byang chub tshul khrims/ bsod nams snying po/ thugs rje brtson 'grus/ shes rab 'bum/ bzang po dpal/ byang chub rtse mo/ dkon mchog tshul khrims/ shākya bsod nams/ brtson 'grus bzang po/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/

des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med de'i drung du/ dpal ldan nā ro'i gsang spyod thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ rje sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten mgon po/ gling ras/ gtsang pa rgya ras/ rgod tshang pa/ u rgyan pa/ mkhas grub zla ba seng ge/ slob dpon rin po che thams can mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med de'i drung du/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa nyams khrid lung dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo/ shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal sum cu so lnga/ grub chen dus zhabs pa chen po/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ rgyal sras nā lan+d+ra ba/ paṇa chen zla ba mgon po/ 'brom ston lo tsā/ bla ma lha rje dgon pa/ sgro ston rnam brtsegs/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ dharma shwa ra/ mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer/ ma cig sprul sku jo 'bum/ grub thob se go che ba/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ chos rje kun spangs chen po/ chos rje byang sems chen po/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rgyal sras rat+na shrī/ chos rje pra dz+nyā ku ṇa/ chos rje mkhas grub yab sras/ 'khrul zhig tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de'i drung du/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i 'khor lo lnga ma'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mgon po klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ a bh+ya yā ka ra/ sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma ja tshul ba/ slob dpon mgon gzhon pa/ dbon po rgyal mchog bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/
