slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rin chen/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ gcod skal ldan thar lam dang stan thog gcig ma gnyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gzhung gi brgyud pa/ thabs kyi brgyud pa/ shes rab kyi brgyud pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ thub dbang*/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ ār+ya de wa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ skyo ston bsod nams bla ma/ ma cig lab sgron/ rtsi ston dar ma/ glang lung pa/ sāl pa skal ldan/ mal gro ba gru pa 'bar/ spang po ba shākya bla ma/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ rin chen gzhon nu/ sgro ston chen po/ rin chen 'od zer/ chos kyi dbang phyug zhen med ras pa/ gzhon nu bzang po/ ye shes 'od zer/ shes rab seng ge/ blo gsal ri khrod pa/ 'khrul zhig tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ ār+ya de wa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ bsod nams bla ma/ ma cig lab sgron/ khu sgom chos sing*/ dol pa zang thal/ rgya nag gcer bu/ sangs rgyas rab ston/ sangs rgyas dge ston/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ chos rje gser gling pa/ rdo rje dpal/ chos dpal shes rab/ blo gsal ri khrod/ 'khrul zhig tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //shes rab kyi brgyud pa ni/ yum chen mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ su kha sid+dhi/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ ma cig lab sgron/ rgyal ba don grub/ dam pa dbus pa/ rdo rje bde ba/ gzhon nu ye shes/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ 'gro mgon lung bstan pa/ gdan gcig pa chen po/ bsam gtan dar/ mi nyag rin rgyal ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pa/ slob dpon rin po che 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan pa/

des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang slob dpon rin po che'i drung du/ thugs rje chen po dmar khrid nyams khrid du thob par byas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yi dam thugs rje chen po/ grub thob tshem bu pa chen po/ gnyan ras dar ma 'od/ bdag med ma/ rngog btsun dkar mo/ des jo bo shākya bya ba/ des spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od/ des stag sde brag dmar ba byang chub tshul khrims/ des lha sde dgon gsar ba/ des zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus/ des rin chen shes rab 'bum/ des rgyal sras thogs med rin po che/ des grub chen byang chub rtse mo/ des byang sems dkon mchog tshul khrims/ des 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de'i drung du/ dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i 'khor lo lnga ma'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ ā bha yā ka ra/ rtswa mi lo tsā ba/ dpal chen rga lo/ rje phag mo gru pa/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma bya tshul ba/ slob dpon sngags pa se mo ba/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ rgyal ba ye shes/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen chen po/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs 'phags 'od/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston rin chen grub/ 'jam dbyangs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan legs pa/ dus 'khor ba don grub kun dga'/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba/

des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang na rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rga lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge/ rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin chen grub/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan legs pa/ dus 'khor ba don grub kun dga'/ dbon po rgyal mchog sa skya pa'i bdag po grags pa blo gros/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ phag gru/ 'jig rten mgon po/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal ba gcung*/ thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/ nyer gnyis pa/ don grub rgyal po/ sman sgom pa/ de gnyis ka la 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ de la mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ de la slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de'i drung du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal sum cu so lnga/ dus zhabs che chung*/ zla ba mgon po/ lha rje sgom pa/ sgro gnam la rtsegs/ yung mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras mchog dharma shwa ra/ grub thob/ slob dpon mgon gzhon pa/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon po rgyal mchog sa skya pa'i bdag po grags pa blo gros/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o//

༈ //slob dpon rin po che de'i drung du/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ ā bha yā ka ra/ rtswa mi lo tsā/ dpal rga lo/ phag mo gru pa/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma ja tshul ba/ slob dpon sngags pa/ slob dpon mgon gzhon pa/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon po rgyal mchog sa skya pa'i bdag po grags pa blo gros/ mnyam med ngag gi dbang po/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na phag gru pa yan gong dang 'dra/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ spyan snga chos kyi rje/ rgyal ba/ slob dpon dwags po/ yang na phag mo gru pa/ rgya brag kha ba/ slob dpon dwags po/ spyan snga grags she/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen dpal bzang po ba/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na rong pa shes rab seng ge/ kyin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen chen po/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ theg chen chos rje/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan legs pa phyin gong 'dra'o// yang na rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rong pa bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' 'phags/ chos rje dus 'khor ba/ slob dpon dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba/ des bdag la'o// yang na dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang*/ longs sku dus kyi 'khor lo/ sprul sku shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal nyi shu rtsa gsum/ dam pa dus zhabs che chung*/ paṇa chen zla ba mgon/ sgro ston rnam rtseg pa/ yung mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras dharma shwa ra/ mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer/ se mo che ba/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/

mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar kha bka' bzhi pa/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// yang na chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal yan gong dang 'dra/ chos rje sman shrī/ zho lung mtsho ba/ yon tan 'phel/ rtogs ldan tshangs pa rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med chos kyi rje de'i drung du/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dzā lan+dha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ lu hi pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa/ klog skya ba/ rma lo tsā/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ bsod nams dpal/ bla chen pa/ nam tshul ba/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ rgyal ba dbang po karma pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rje til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pak+ṣi/ u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba/ rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal po/ grub chen tshangs pa rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o//

༈ //yang mnyam med de'i drung du/ kye'i rdo rje'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ ba ri wa ba/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā/ se 'khar chung pa/ zhang sgom pa/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa/ mkhas pa nya dbon po/ chos rje dkon mchog bzang po/ slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin chen de'i drung du/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ā bha yā ka ra/ dpal rga lo/ rtag byang chub sems dpa'/ 'dan sgom/ slob dpon ri khrod pa/ tsan+d+ra kīrti/ pra dz+nyā ga ga ti/ bla ma sku yal ba/ byang chub grags/ kun dga' seng ge/ bla ma byang chub bzang po/ mkhan chen pa/ tsan+d+ra dh+wa dza/ chos grags pa/ drung dbu ma pa/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang phag mo phur zhabs ma thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ yar byon pa/ bkra shis bla ma/ dpal bzang po/ rat+na gu ru/ rat+na ka ra/ kun spangs chen po/ bkra shis dpal rtsegs/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rje ngag dbang grags pa/ slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rin chen dpal bzang po/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rje mnyam med de nyid kyi drung du/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā zhi la pu/ pra dz+nyā bho dhi/ bhu ti ko sha/ dharma pha la/ jo bo rje/ gdol pa sgom chen/

spyi nor dz+nyā na/ nyi ma shes rab/ sbur chen po/ bshes gnyen rdor si/ bstan chos 'byung*/ snubs ston shākya 'bum/ 'dzing pa rin she/ yang rtsib rin seng*/ bu ston rin chen grub/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyain pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rin chen dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rje mnyam med de'i drung du/ gter gyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug pad+ma dbang chen/ sras kun grol/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka bi ra ṭi/ ba ri ghar+bha/ bha ba ri ma ti/ ni ka la ka ri ba/ cal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ rje btsun rga lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ kun spangs rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ chos rje dpal ldan legs pa/ chos rje dkon mchog bzang po/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med pa'i dam pa de nyid kyi drung du/ u rgyan gu ru pad+ma drag po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku snang ba mtha' yas/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ 'od phran dpal gyi 'byung gnas/ 'od phran chos kyi 'byung gnas/ 'od phran seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'od phran grags pa rgya mtsho/

'od phran don grub dpal 'byor/ 'od phran dbang gi rgyal po/ 'od phran rta mchog rin chen/ 'od phran grub chen ri rab brtan pa/ rin chen don grub dpal 'byor/ rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ gu ru drag po'i sgrub thabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ snang ba mtha' yas/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ chos kyi dbang phyug pad+ma dbang chen/ ḍā ki kun grol 'bum/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rdo rje/ zur khang chos rje/ dpal bzang po/ shākya bshes gnyen/ grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje don grub dpal 'byor pa/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med chos rje de'i drung du/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rig 'dzin rin chen bzang po/ lo ro sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'bar ston tshul khrims 'od zer/ drin can nam mkha' 'od zer/ de sras dpal ldan seng ge/ rgyan mchog gnyis kas/ 'jam dpal dharma shwa ra/ bla chen grags pa rin chen/ sngags 'chang nam mkha' tshul khrims/ des slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po de'i drung du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rdo rje 'chang*/ mgon po klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ ā bha yā ka ra/

rtswa mi lo tsā ba/ dpal rga lo/ rje phag mo gru pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma ja tshul ba/ slob dpon sngags pa/ slob dpon mgon gzhon pa/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon po rgyal mchog bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ mnyam med ngag gi dbang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rin chen pa/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang mnyam med rin po che de nyid kyi drung*/ blo sbyong don bdun ma cha lag dang bcas pa/ sa skya pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid/ skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid/ phyag mtshan mchod rten drung thob kyi khrid/ lhan cig skyes sbyor yang dgon pa'i lugs kyi khrid/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe khrid/ ras chung lugs kyi tshe khrid/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong gi khrid/ rje nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus kyi khrid/ rje til+li pa'i phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma'i khrid/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i bshad pa/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa/ sbom po brgyad kyi bshad pa/ rnal 'byor pa brgyad kyi bshad 'grel pa/ rje dwags po'i chos bzhi'i bshad pa/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong*/ rwa lo tsā ba'i byad bzlog gong khug ma/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma/ spyod 'jug bshes springs/ gcod kyi dmigs 'bum/ blo sbyong*/ chos dang chos min rnam 'byed/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ sman bla'i mdo chog mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i lung*/ cha gsum lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ nor bu rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ spyod bsdus sgron me/ sher snying sa bcad dang*/ mdo rtsa'i lung*/ chos spyod rab gsal/ so so thar pa'i mdo/ seng gdong can gyi sgrub thabs yig ge bcu bzhi pa dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud rim ma chod// ༈ //yang mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po de nyid kyi drung du/

sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dbang thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ thog mar dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'byung ba'i blo gros zhabs kyi mdzad pa/ yang dam tshig gsum gyi sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs gsum khams pa lo tsā ba ris bsgyur ba/ yi ge drug pa rig pa chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ za ma tog bkod pa'i man ngag gis mdzad pa'i yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ yang yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ kha sar+pa ṇi'-i sgrub thabs dpon rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ po ta la'i kha sar+pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan kha sar+pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon sgeg byed kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs a nu sa ma rak+ṣi tas cung zad rgyas par mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra yi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta a wa dhū ti gnyis med zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ yang 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ yang seng ge sgra yi sgrub thabs gsum/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa rol pas mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs/ cho ga bsdus pa pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ yang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sa ra has mdzad pa/ yang 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs au ḍi yā na las byung zhing sa ra has gdan drangs pa/

'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ de'i cho ga ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgrin pa sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ sran ma maṣa'i zhal gyi gzungs/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rig pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa 'phags ma sbug ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon sha ne pa mi ta pradz+nyā pa ta'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ rten pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ba gan dhas mdzad pa/ tshig lhug pa brten pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs seng ge sgra yi sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ yang dag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs gnyis shes rab 'phel ba'i gter ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta phrag dog rdo rjes mdzad pa/ yang dag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ tshig lhug par a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal sgom pa'i man ngag a ra pa tsa na 'phral du nyams su myong ba dang lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs kyi dbang du bya ba'i cho ga sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ yang a ra pa tsa yi sgrub thabs/ ngag gi sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang dag gi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal rgyal po chen po rol pa'i sgrub thabs/

'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ bung ba myos pa'i sgrub thabs/ lhag par dbang du byed pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ yang 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs gcig rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las byung ba'i bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod so so nas bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag shes rab 'khor lo'i dngos grub mchog thob pa la sgrub thabs/ chos kyi dbyings ting nge 'dzin 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ yi ge gcig pa rab tu sbyor ba'i sgrub thabs/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ cho ga dang bcas pa'i slob dpon 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pas mdzad pa/ gtum mo chen po'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ yang gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ mchog sbyin sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang tu byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa gsum/ yang rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po chos 'byung blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrubs thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rin chen 'byung ldan zhi ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs cung zad rgyas pa paṇ+ḍi ta gnas brtan chen po dpe med bsrung bas mdzad pa/ 'phags ma 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag chen mo rig ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'chi ba slu ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/

'chi ba 'joms pa sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i slob ma thu bos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od dpag med kyi rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtogs pa gsungs pa ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs/ don thams cad grub pa rab tu sbyin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i cho ga 'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i gzungs gsum/ 'phags ma dug sel ma rigs sngags chen mo/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i rtogs pa/ 'phags ma dzam gu la'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis grub pa/ yang ral cig ma'i sgrub thabs gsum/ tsu ta'i sgrub thabs gsum/ rtog pa las gsungs pa 'od zer can dkar mo phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi cho ga 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma 'od zer gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can phyag rgya ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs/ au ḍi yā na'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs gnyis/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa 'od zer can gyi rig pa'i sgrub thabs/ rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon snying po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal 'od zer can pi tsu wa'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ mdor bsdus pa 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/

'od zer can gyi gzungs 'don pa'i man ngag ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs gnyis/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dge 'dun byin gyis mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma 'phel gyis mdzad pa/ gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ dbyangs can ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje pi waṃ dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs gsum/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs gnyis/ sgrol ma'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i ku ru ku le'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i ku ru ku le'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru ku le dbang du byed pa'i man ngag rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ u rgyan nas byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ lhan cig skyes pa rol pa'i mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i rim pa las ku ru ku le'i sgrub thabs/ yang rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud las bton pa/ ku ru ku le phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ dga' byed phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang ku ru ku le'i sgrub thabs/

dga' byed ma'i man ngag gi rim pa/ dga' byed ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ yang ku ru ku le'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ yang ku ru ku le'i sgrub thabs/ rtogs pa las byung ba'i ku ru ku le'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru ku le las rab tu skyong ba/ sbyor ba gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdugs dkar po can gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje tsar rtsa'i ka'i sgrub thabs/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs gsum/ rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma stong chen mo rab tu 'jom ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bstan pa/ phyir bzlog pa chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gan+dha ri'i sgrub thabs/ yang gnyis/ bsrung ba lnga yi cho ga rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta dbu ma pa ka ru sgra chos kyi 'byung gnas blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ yang nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs gcig nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag phag mo'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ṭi ta chen po a wa dhū ti gnyis med zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi snang ba sgrub pa'i cho ga rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtogs pa don thams cad grub pa/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ yang dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bar gyi man ngag dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs/ dpal dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/

yang dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ yang dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs/ dzaṃ bha la'i chu rgyun 'bul ba'i man ngag rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ gshin rje dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs gnyis/ gshin rje bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ de'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs/ de'i cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyis rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams dang*/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs gnyis rnams la chos tshan nyi brgya lnga bcu tham pa yod pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ ā bha yā ka ra/ 'tshur lam ka ra/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ bud+dha shrī/ bho dhi paṇ+ḍi ta/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ rong pa sher seng*/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen rin chen 'phel/ ye shes 'phel/ kun dga' bsod nams/ rdo rje seng ge/ ma ti paṇa chen/

byang chub sangs rgyas/ shes rab 'od zer/ bag ston/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan rin chen rnam par rgyal ba/ des bdag ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //gang sngon tshogs gnyis rgya mtshor legs 'khrungs bslab gsum 'byor pas rgyas// rim gnyis byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i bsam pa'i bang rim can// sku gsum lhun grub rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs mchog gi sprul pa'i sku brnyes pa// theg gsum mngon gyur shākya'i dge slong kun gtso khyod zhabs 'dud// 'phags yul sbyangs pa mthar phyin kha che paṇ+ḍi ta// shākya shrī'-i ring lugs 'dzin zhing rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// gang de'i rgyal tshab dbang bskur mchog brnyes dgra bcom kun dga' mtshan// yongs 'dzin thub dbang gnyis pa de dag gis ni bdag skyongs shig /ces brjod nas/ chos lung tshogs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pa mkhan chen rin po che kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas kyi drung du/ chos thob pa la/ thog mar sangs rgyas kyi bstan par rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul las/ dge bsnyen nyid dang dge tshul nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bar legs par thob pa'i mkhan brgyud ni/ bcom ldan thub pa nyid dang shā ri'i bu// sgra gcan zin dang rab tu bzang po dang*/ klu sgrub snying po gu ṇa ma ti dang*// rat+na mi tra dharma pā la dang*// gu ṇa pa ti chos kyi phreng ba dang*// 'byung gnas sbas pa paṇa chen shākya shrī// mkhan chen byang chub dpal dang bde ba dpal// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*// bsod nams grags pa grags pa gshes gnyen dang*// zla ba blo gros rgyal ba phyag na dang*// bshes gnyen bzang po nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang*// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kun dga' blo gros te// rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' rat+na'i zhabs// rnam dag mkhan brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa rnams yin no// yang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa rje de nyid kyi drung du/

mgon po tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ bde gshegs khams pa rdo rgyal/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan snga 'bri gung pa/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ thugs sras spyan snga rin ldan/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de gnyis ka la drung chos grags pas gsan/ de la chos rje rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje kun dga' blo gros rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rje rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen bsod rtse/ rje btsun sa paṇa/ lho brag pa/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa/ rin po che ba/ grags rgyal ba/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ zla ba blo gros/ des rje btsun kun dga' blo gros la/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rje btsun chos kyi rje de nyid kyi drung du/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi rjes gnang rgyas par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ g.yor po jo bstan/ bu gces bsod nams rin chen/ mdzod phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/ stag pa jo bzang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa dpal/ lho brag pa/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi bsod nams grags/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje kun dga' blo gros/ des bdag la'o// yang na chos rje kun blo ba/ chos rje don rgyal ba dang*/

chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan ba gnyis ka la gsan// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ khro bo sme brtsegs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ 'bri phug pa bsod rdor/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros rin chen chos kyi dbang phyug des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rigs gsum mgon po/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen bsod brtse/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ snur ye rgyal/ snur chos 'phags/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gar thig pa mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ mkhan chen grags rdor ba/ byang chub rdo rje rin rgyal ba/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ chos rje kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ bcom ldan 'das gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ba'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ de'i gzungs kyi bka' lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ skal ldan grags pa/ shī la a kar ma ti/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ bsod rtse ba/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa/ dga' ldan ba rgan mo lhas pa/ slob dpon ston pa/ bsod dbang*/ lo mchog dbang lo/ bsod grags/ grags rgyal/ rin rgyal ba/ rgyal ba phyag na/ chos kyi rje kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

dpal rta mgrin/ dbon ston skyer pa sgang pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ 'jag chen shes rab tshul khrims/ 'jags chen rgyal mtshan 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen zla ba blo gros/ mkhan chen rin po che kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ dbus pa zi ston/ gnam kho'u pa/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ shes rab dpal/ glo bo shes rab rin chen/ chos rgyal ba/ rong pa sher seng*/ kun dga' tshul khrims/ bag ston/ tshul rgyal ba/ bsod rin pa/ chos grags pa/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' blo gros pa/ des bdag kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o// ༈ //yang rin po che de nyid kyi drung du/ sgrol ma ljang khu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob
